intro.title: Pilih Akses (Choose Access)
intro.desc: This page appears when your account is not allowed to open the Dashboard, for example a staff account. It holds shortcuts to the pages you may use — press one of the cards to start working.

cards.title: Shortcut cards
cards.desc:
• Transaksi — the cashier screen for selling.
  • Pelanggan — your regular customers.
  • Piutang — money customers still owe you (receivables).
  • Hutang — money you still owe suppliers (payables).
  • Supplier — supplier details.
  • Laporan — sales reports.
Only the cards you are allowed to open are shown.

empty.title: No access yet
empty.desc: Your account has not been given permission to open any page. Ask the store owner to choose an Akses Group (role, for example cashier) for your account in the Users menu, then reload this page.

menu.title: Main menu
menu.desc: The same pages are also in this menu. You only see the menus you are allowed to open.

toggle.title: Menu button (☰)
toggle.desc: On a phone the main menu is hidden — press this button to open it. On a wide screen, this button shrinks the menu.

intro.title: Aging & Pengingat (Aging & Reminders)
intro.desc:
A summary of two kinds of debt: payables — what the store still owes suppliers — and receivables — what customers still owe the store. Aging means the age of a debt: debts are grouped by how many days they are past the due date (the deadline to pay). Each group is called an aging bucket.

Open this page regularly, for example every Monday, to see what to pay and what to collect.

cards.title: Summary figures
cards.desc:
• Total Hutang (total payables) — money you still owe suppliers.
  • Total Piutang (total receivables) — money customers still owe you.
  • … akan jatuh tempo (… due soon) — notes due within 3 days or already past due.
  • Hutang Overdue and Piutang Overdue — debts more than 60 days late (overdue = past the due date).

payables.title: Aging Hutang Supplier (supplier payables aging)
payables.desc:
Supplier debts by age group:
  • Belum Jatuh Tempo (not yet due) — not time to pay yet.
  • 1-30 Hari (days) — up to 30 days late.
  • 31-60 Hari, 61-90 Hari, 90+ Hari — later and later.
On the right: the unpaid amount and the number of notes. The Akan Jatuh Tempo (due soon) list, when shown, has the nearest notes; press one to open it in Supplier Payables and record the payment.

receivables.title: Aging Piutang Pelanggan (customer receivables aging)
receivables.desc: The same groups for customer debts. Chase the oldest late debts first — the longer they wait, the harder they are to collect. Press a note in the Akan Jatuh Tempo (due soon) list, when shown, to open it, then record the customer's payment there with Tambah Pembayaran (add payment).

intro.title: Audit Log
intro.desc:
An automatic record of important activity in the app: who did what, when, and from which device. For example sign-ins and failed sign-ins, price changes, stock adjustments, new purchase orders, deleted users, or changed permissions.

Open this page when something looks wrong — for example stock that doesn't match or a price that changed without you knowing. Entries here can only be read; they cannot be changed or deleted.

filters.title: Filter the entries
filters.desc:
Choices in this box filter the list straight away:
  • Semua Aktor (all actors) — pick a person.
  • Semua Modul (all modules) — a part of the app, for example auth (sign-in/out), stock, users.
  • Semua Event (all events) — the kind of activity.
  • Two date boxes — from date and to date.
  • The Cari target atau deskripsi (search target or description) box — for example an item name or PO number.

list.title: Histori Audit (audit history)
list.desc:
Newest first:
  • Waktu (time) — when it happened.
  • Aktor (actor) — who (name and email). System means nobody was signed in, for example a failed sign-in attempt.
  • Modul (module) — the part of the app.
  • Target — the data affected, for example an item name or PO number.
  • Deskripsi (description) — a short explanation.
Except for super-admins, you only see entries of users in your outlets.

event.title: What event names mean
event.desc:
Event names are written part.what_happened. Examples:
  • auth.login_succeeded / auth.login_failed — signed in / failed to sign in (wrong password).
  • auth.locked_out — temporarily locked after too many wrong attempts.
  • security.privileged_action_challenged — asked to retype the password for an important action.
  • product.price_updated — an item's price was changed.
  • stock.adjusted — stock was changed, for example by a stock count.
  • user.role_changed — a user's access group was changed.
The endings created, updated, deleted, and cancelled mean what they say.

row.title: Detail
row.desc: Press Detail to open the full entry: the data before and after the change (for example the old and new price), the device's internet address, and the browser that was used.

empty.title: No entries
empty.desc: No entries match. If you are filtering, set the choices back to Semua … (all) and clear the dates and the search box.

pagination.title: Pages
pagination.desc: Use the page numbers or arrows to see older entries, and choose how many entries show per page (10, 25, or 50).

intro.title: Detail Audit Log (audit entry)
intro.desc: The full record of one activity. The line under the title names the event and its module — event names are explained in the guide of the Audit Logs page. This page is read-only.

summary.title: Who, what, when
summary.desc:
• Waktu (time) — when it was recorded.
  • Aktor (actor) — who did it; System = nobody was signed in.
  • Target — the data affected; the small line below is its data type and number in the system.
  • Client — the internet address (IP) and the device or browser used. A device you don't recognise deserves a closer look.

desc.title: Deskripsi (description)
desc.desc: A short explanation of what happened, for example Login gagal. (sign-in failed) or Harga produk diperbarui. (product price updated).

changes.title: Before and After
changes.desc: Before = the data before the change, After = the data after it. Compare the same line on both sides to see what changed — for example a selling price of 8000 that became 9000. Tidak ada data. (no data) means that side is empty: new data has no Before, deleted data has no After.

meta.title: Meta
meta.desc: Extra details for investigating, for example severity (how important: info, warning, high, critical), route (the action or page used), or the email typed during a failed sign-in.

back.title: Kembali (back)
back.desc: Press Kembali (back) to return to the audit log list.

intro.title: Shift Kasir (Cashier Shifts)
intro.desc:
A shift is a cashier's working period: opened when they start selling, closed when they finish. While the shift runs, the app works out how much cash should be in the drawer; at closing, the drawer is counted and compared. A cashier needs an open shift to be able to sell.

Example: the morning shift opens at 08:00 with Rp 100,000 of small change in the drawer.

view_active.title: Lihat Shift Aktif (view active shift)
view_active.desc: Opens the details of your running shift. That is where you close the shift at the end of your work: count the cash in the drawer and type in the amount.

open.title: Buka Shift Baru (open a new shift)
open.desc: Shown when you have no open shift. You can also open a shift directly from the cashier screen. A cashier can only have one open shift at a time.

cash.title: Modal Awal (opening cash)
cash.desc: The cash in the drawer before you start selling — usually small change. Type the number only, for example 100000 for Rp 100,000. Empty drawer? Leave it blank or type 0.

warehouse.title: Gudang / Cabang (warehouse / branch)
warehouse.desc: Choose the branch where you are selling. Stock of sold items is taken from this warehouse, and the sales are recorded under this branch.

notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
notes.desc: Extra information, for example morning shift or the name of a stand-in cashier.

submit.title: Buka Shift (open shift)
submit.desc: Press it after entering the opening cash. The shift starts right away and its details page opens. To start selling, open the Transactions menu (the cashier screen).

active.title: Your active shift
active.desc:
• Shift Aktif (active shift) — the cashier's name and branch.
  • Modal Awal (opening cash) — the cash in the drawer when the shift opened.
  • Expected Cash — the cash that should be in the drawer now (explained in the next step).
  • Total Transaksi (transactions) — the number of sales in this shift.

expected.title: Expected Cash
expected.desc:
Expected Cash = the cash that should be in the drawer:
opening cash + paid cash sales − cash refunds + cash in − cash out.

Transfers, QRIS, and pay-later sales are not counted because that money never enters the drawer. Example: 100,000 opening + 250,000 cash sales − 20,000 for a water refill = 330,000.

buttons.title: Report X, cash in, cash out
buttons.desc:
• Cetak Laporan X (print report X) — an interim report of the running shift; the shift is not closed. It opens in a new tab; print it with the browser's Print menu.
  • Kas Masuk (cash in) — record money put into the drawer outside of sales, for example extra small change.
  • Kas Keluar (cash out) — record money taken out, for example to buy a water refill or hand over to the owner.
Fill in Nominal (amount) and Keterangan (description), then press Simpan (save). Expected Cash adjusts immediately.

filters.title: Filter the history
filters.desc: Filter the shift history by cashier (when there are several), status, and opening date — the first date box is "from", the second "to". The list updates as soon as you choose.

history.title: Histori Shift Kasir (shift history)
history.desc:
Every shift, newest first:
  • Kasir (cashier) and their opening cash.
  • Status: Open = still running, Closed = closed by the cashier, Force Closed = closed by a supervisor.
  • Buka / Tutup (opened / closed) — when the shift was opened and closed.
  • Expected Cash — the cash that should be in the drawer.
On a phone, swipe the table sideways.

row.title: Difference and details
row.desc: Selisih (difference) = the cash counted at closing minus Expected Cash. 0 means it matched; a minus figure (for example -Rp 5.000) means the drawer was short; a plus figure means there was extra. Press the eye icon at the far right to see the shift details.

empty.title: No shifts yet
empty.desc: No shifts recorded yet, or none match the filter. The first shift is opened with the Buka Shift Baru (open a new shift) form above, or from the cashier screen.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: A long history is split over several pages. Use the page numbers to see older shifts, and Tampilkan (show) to choose 10, 25, or 50 shifts per page.

intro.title: Cashier shift details
intro.desc:
A summary of one shift: drawer cash, sales, and returns. At the end of the working period, the shift is closed here: count the cash in the drawer, type in the amount, and compare it with the app's figures.

Example: the morning cashier finishes at 15:00 and counts the drawer before handing the money to the owner.

status.title: Shift status
status.desc:
• Shift Aktif (active) — still running; the cashier can sell.
  • Shift Closed — closed by the cashier.
  • Force Closed — closed by a supervisor (owner or manager) instead of the cashier.

report_z.title: Cetak Laporan Z (print report Z)
report_z.desc: Shown once the shift is closed. Report Z is the final shift report: cash and non-cash sales, returns, cash in/out, opening cash, Expected Cash, counted cash, and the difference. It opens in a new tab; print it with the browser's Print menu and keep it with the handed-over cash.

metrics.title: Key figures
metrics.desc:
• Modal Awal (opening cash) — the cash in the drawer when the shift opened.
  • Expected Cash — what should be in the drawer: opening cash + cash sales − cash refunds + cash in − cash out.
  • Penjualan Tunai (cash sales) — sales paid in cash.
  • Refund Tunai (cash refunds) — return money paid back in cash from the drawer.

summary.title: Ringkasan Shift (shift summary)
summary.desc: The cashier, the branch, who opened and closed the shift, and when it was closed. Also Total Transaksi (sales), Total Retur (returns), Penjualan Non Tunai (non-cash sales: transfer, QRIS, pay later — not in the drawer), Refund Non Tunai (returns given as store credit), and the notes made when the shift was opened and closed.

closing.title: Cash Closing
closing.desc: The drawer check: Expected Cash (according to the app), Actual Cash (the cash really counted at closing), and the Selisih (difference) between them. While the shift is still running, Actual Cash and Selisih stay empty (-).

close.title: Tutup Shift (close shift)
close.desc: Shown while the shift is running, to the cashier or an authorised supervisor. Close the shift at the end of the working period, after the last sale. Once closed, the cashier must open a new shift to sell again.

actual.title: Kas Fisik Aktual (counted cash)
actual.desc: Count all the cash in the drawer — including the opening cash — and type the amount, for example 330000. The Selisih closing (closing difference) box appears right away: green when it matches (0), yellow when there is a difference (minus = short, plus = extra).

notes.title: Catatan Closing (closing notes, optional)
notes.desc: Explain any difference, for example gave Rp 5,000 too much change or Rp 200,000 already handed to the owner. This note is printed on Report Z too.

finalize.title: Finalisasi Closing (finalise closing)
finalize.desc: Closes the shift with the amount you typed. This cannot be undone: the shift's figures are locked, and the cashier cannot sell until a new shift is opened. Closing another cashier's shift is recorded as Force Closed and asks for your password again. Afterwards the Cetak Laporan Z (print report Z) button appears.

intro.title: Categories Page
intro.desc: A category is a group of items, for example Drinks, Groceries, or Cigarettes. Every product must belong to one category, and on the cashier screen categories appear as filter buttons so items are found quickly. New store? Create a few categories here first, then add your products.

add.title: Tambah Kategori (Add Category)
add.desc: Press Tambah Kategori (add category) to create a new group. Only the name is required — the picture and description can be skipped.

search.title: Search categories
search.desc: Type part of a name, for example minum to find Minuman, then press Enter (on a phone: the search or ↵ key on the keyboard). To see everything again, clear the box and press Enter.

view.title: Tile or table view
view.desc: These two buttons switch between tiles (picture cards) and a table (number, name, and description on one line). The content is the same. Each time the page is reopened, it goes back to tiles.

list.title: Category list
list.desc: Each category shows its picture (or an icon when it has none), its name, and its description. The newest category comes first. The number under the page title is the total number of categories.

row.title: Edit or delete
row.desc: In tile view, point at or tap the picture of a category to show the pencil (edit) and bin (delete) buttons. In table view, the buttons are at the right end of the row. Deleting cannot be undone, and a category still used by products cannot be deleted — first move those products to another category on the Products page.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.desc: This store has no categories yet. Press Tambah Kategori (add category) and create the first one, for example Minuman (drinks). Products can then be put into it.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there are many categories, the list is split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and choose how many categories show at once (10, 25, or 50).

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Categories ready? Open the Products menu, press Tambah Produk (add product), and choose the right category for each item. On the cashier screen, items are grouped by these categories automatically.

intro.title: Add or edit a category
intro.desc: This form creates a new category (Tambah Kategori Baru) or changes an existing one (Edit Kategori). Only Nama Kategori (category name) is required; the picture and description may stay empty. Example categories for a small shop: Drinks, Groceries, Cigarettes, Snacks.

image.title: Gambar (Picture, optional)
image.desc: A small picture for the category, shown on its card on the Categories page. Press the file button and pick a photo from your gallery or camera — a preview appears in the box above. Use JPG or PNG, at most 2 MB. When editing, leave it empty to keep the old picture.

name.title: Nama Kategori (Name, required)
name.desc: The group's name, for example Cold Drinks. It appears as a category button on the cashier screen and in the Kategori (category) choice when adding a product, so use a short name the cashier will recognise.

description.title: Deskripsi (Description, optional)
description.desc: A short note on what the category holds, for example Tea, coffee, and bottled water. Shown only on the Categories page, never printed on receipts.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save; when editing: Simpan Perubahan, save changes). On success you return to the category list with a confirmation message. If the name is empty, red text appears under it — fill it in and save again. Batal (cancel) returns to the list without saving.

intro.title: CRM Campaigns
intro.desc: A campaign is a WhatsApp message sent to a group of customers at once — for example an end-of-month promo for all members, or a reminder about tabs that are nearly due. You choose the recipients (from segments and other filters), write the message, then process it into a send list. Start with Buat Campaign (create campaign).

add.title: Buat Campaign (create campaign)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new campaign: name, recipients, and message. Messages are sent automatically over WhatsApp only when Settings → WhatsApp is connected and enabled; otherwise you send them one by one with the WhatsApp button on the campaign's detail page.

filters.title: Filter by type and status
filters.desc: Tipe (type): Promo Broadcast (promo message), Invoice Share (sending a receipt), Due Date Reminder (receivable due date), Repeat Order Reminder (invitation to buy again). The two reminder types are also created automatically by the system every night. Status: Draft, Ready, Processed, Cancelled — explained in the next step.

list.title: Daftar CRM Campaign (campaign list)
list.desc:
• Campaign — name and creator; press the name to open the details.
  • Tipe (type) — the campaign kind (an English code, for example promo_broadcast).
  • Status — draft: just saved, recipients not built yet; ready: the send list is ready; processed: every message is marked sent; cancelled: called off.
  • Log — the number of recipients on the send list.

row.title: Edit or delete a campaign
row.desc: Press the campaign name to open its details and send list. At the right end of the row: the pencil edits it, the bin deletes the campaign and its send list — this cannot be undone. Messages already sent cannot be recalled. On a phone, swipe the table left to see the buttons.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.desc: No campaign matches the filters. Choose Semua Tipe and Semua Status (all), or press Buat Campaign (create campaign).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

intro.title: Filling in a campaign
intro.desc: This form builds one campaign: a name, who receives it (Audience Builder — the recipient list builder), and the message. Only Nama Campaign (campaign name) is required. Example: Payday Promo for all members, with a message about 10% off on Saturday.

name.title: Nama Campaign (name, required)
name.desc: A name for yourself, for example October Payday Promo. It is not sent to customers. Without a name, the save button saves nothing.

type.title: Tipe Campaign (type)
type.desc: A label for the campaign kind: Promo Broadcast (promo message), Due Date Reminder (tab due-date reminder), or Repeat Order Reminder (invitation to buy again). The type only groups campaigns; the recipients are still set by the Audience Builder below. The type cannot be changed after saving.

channel.title: Channel
channel.desc: How the campaign is recorded: WhatsApp Link (WhatsApp message) or Internal (a follow-up note for your team). Whichever you choose, every recipient gets a WhatsApp button on the detail page, and messages are sent automatically when the store's WhatsApp is connected.

draft.title: Simpan sebagai draft (save as draft)
draft.desc: Ticked (default): the campaign is saved as a draft first; the recipient list is built later with the Proses Audience (process audience) button on the detail page. Untick it to process straight away when saving — if WhatsApp is connected, messages are sent immediately to everyone. When editing a campaign, this option has no effect.

segments.title: Segment Customer (customer segments)
segments.desc: Tick the customer groups to send to, for example VIP Pelanggan. If you tick several, customers in any of them are included. None ticked = all customers (then narrowed by the choices below). Segments are created in the Customer Segments menu.

customer_type.title: Customer Type
customer_type.desc: Semua Customer (all), only Loyalty Member (active members), or only Non Member.

receivable.title: Status Piutang (tab status)
receivable.desc:
Filter by what customers still owe the store (piutang = a receivable, an unpaid tab):
  • Semua Status Piutang — no filter.
  • Punya Piutang — still has an unpaid tab.
  • Piutang Overdue — the tab is past its due date.
  • Jatuh Tempo H-3 — due between today and 3 days from now.

voucher.title: Voucher Filter
voucher.desc: Semua Customer (all), only those who Punya Voucher Aktif (have an active voucher), or those who Tidak Punya Voucher Aktif (don't). Example: choose the first to remind customers to use their voucher before it expires.

message.title: Template Pesan (message)
message.desc: The WhatsApp message. Write {{name}} to insert the customer's name and {{phone}} for their phone number. Example: Hi {{name}}, all drinks are 10% off this Saturday. See you at the shop! — a customer named Sari receives Hi Sari, …

submit.title: Simpan Campaign (save campaign)
submit.desc: Press Simpan Campaign. You are taken to the campaign's detail page to process and send its messages. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

intro.title: Campaign details
intro.desc: The working page of one campaign. In order: press Proses Audience (process audience) to build the recipient list, send each recipient the message with the WhatsApp button, then mark the ones sent. If the store's WhatsApp is connected (Settings → WhatsApp), messages go out automatically when processed.

header.title: Type and status
header.desc:
The line under the name shows the campaign type, status, and processing time:
  • draft — recipients not built yet.
  • ready — the send list is ready; some messages are not sent yet.
  • processed — every message is marked sent.
  • cancelled — called off.

process.title: Proses Audience (process audience)
process.desc: Shown while the status is draft. Builds the recipient list from the campaign's filters and writes a message for each person; the status then becomes ready. If the store's WhatsApp is connected, messages are sent immediately to recipients with a phone number — check the message before pressing.

cancel.title: Batalkan (cancel)
cancel.desc: Marks the campaign as cancelled. There is no button to undo this, and messages already sent cannot be recalled.

logs.title: Delivery Logs (send list)
logs.desc:
One row per recipient:
  • Customer — name and phone number.
  • Status — pending or ready_to_send (not sent yet), sent, or skipped.
  • Payload — the message for that person.

row.title: Send and mark as sent
row.desc: In the Aksi (actions) column: the green WhatsApp button opens WhatsApp with the message already typed — choose that customer's contact, then send. Once sent, press the double-tick button so the status becomes sent. When everything is sent, the campaign becomes processed. On a phone, swipe the table left.

empty.title: No send list yet
empty.desc: The send list is empty. For a draft campaign, press Proses Audience (process audience). If it is still empty after processing, no customer matched the filters — create a new campaign with looser filters.

snapshot.title: Audience Snapshot
snapshot.desc: A technical record of the recipients at the moment the campaign was processed (customer numbers, names, segments). Nothing to do here — work from the Delivery Logs.

template.title: Template Pesan (message template)
template.desc: The campaign message as written, with {{name}} as the placeholder for the customer's name. Each person's message (with the name filled in) is in the Payload column.

intro.title: CRM Reminders
intro.desc: A queue of every customer follow-up in one list: promo campaigns, shared receipts, receivable due-date reminders, and invitations to buy again. Every night the system creates three automatic reminders: tabs due within 3 days, tabs past their due date, and customers who haven't bought for 30 days. Open this page each morning to follow them up.

filters.title: Filter
filters.desc: Choose a type — Promo Broadcast, Invoice Share (shared receipts), Due Date Reminder (receivable due dates), Repeat Order Reminder (buy-again invitations) — and a status: Draft, Ready (ready to send), Processed (done), Cancelled.

list.title: Reminder & Campaign Queue
list.desc:
• Campaign — name and type. Press the name to open the details and send messages one by one.
  • Status — draft, ready, processed, or cancelled.
  • Target — how many customers to contact.
  • Aksi Cepat (quick actions) — WhatsApp buttons for the first two recipients; press one to open WhatsApp with the message already typed.

row.title: Follow up
row.desc: To mark messages as sent, open the campaign (press its name), then press the double-tick button on each recipient. Automatic reminders with no recipients still appear with 0 target — you can ignore them.

empty.title: Queue empty
empty.desc: No reminders or campaigns yet. Automatic reminders appear after the system has run overnight; promo campaigns are created in the CRM Campaigns menu.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

intro.title: Customer Segments
intro.desc: A segment is a group of customers. It is used to choose who receives promo messages in CRM Campaigns. Examples: a Catering Customers group you fill yourself, or Inactive Customer — customers who haven't bought for 30 days — which the system fills automatically. Press Buat Segment (create segment) to make your own group.

add.title: Buat Segment (create segment)
add.desc: Creates a new group. Choose Manual Tag when you decide the members yourself, for example Catering Customers or Neighbours.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a segment name — the list filters as you type. Choose type Manual or Auto to see one kind only.

list.title: Daftar Segment (segment list)
list.desc:
• Segment — the group name and its description. Press the name to see its members.
  • Tipe (type) — manual: you decide the members; auto: filled automatically by the system every night according to its conditions.
  • Anggota (members) — how many customers are in it.
  • Status — Aktif or Nonaktif (active/inactive). Only active segments can be chosen in CRM Campaigns.

row.title: Open, edit, or delete
row.desc: Press the segment name to see and manage its members. At the right end of the row: the pencil edits it, the bin deletes it. Deleting a segment cannot be undone, but its customers are not deleted. The five built-in automatic segments come back by themselves if deleted. On a phone, swipe the table left to see the buttons.

empty.title: No segments
empty.desc: No segment matches. Clear the search and choose Semua Tipe (all types), or press Buat Segment (create segment).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

next.title: Five automatic segments
next.desc:
The system fills these by itself every night:
  • High Spender — total spending of at least Rp 1,500,000.
  • Frequent Buyer — at least 5 purchases, the latest within 45 days.
  • Inactive Customer — has bought before but not in the last 30 days.
  • Credit Customer — still has an unpaid tab (receivable).
  • Overdue Customer — has a tab past its due date.
Use them as recipients in CRM Campaigns.

intro.title: Filling in a segment
intro.desc: This form creates or edits one customer group. Only Nama Segment (segment name) is required. For a group of your own, choose Manual Tag, save, then add its members on the segment's detail page.

name.title: Nama Segment (name, required)
name.desc: An easy-to-recognise group name, for example Catering Customers or Resellers. It appears as a choice when creating a CRM Campaign.

type.title: Tipe Segment (segment type)
type.desc:
• Manual Tag — you put customers in this group yourself (on the segment's detail page, or in the Tag Manual box on a customer's page).
  • Auto Segment — the system fills it every night. Right now only the five built-in segments (High Spender, Frequent Buyer, Inactive Customer, Credit Customer, Overdue Customer) actually get filled, so for groups of your own use Manual Tag.

description.title: Deskripsi (description, optional)
description.desc: A short note on who belongs here, for example customers who order rice boxes for events. It appears under the segment name in the list.

active.title: Segment aktif (active)
active.desc: Tick it so the segment can be chosen as recipients in CRM Campaigns. An inactive segment stays saved with its members.

auto.title: Rule Auto Segment (automatic conditions)
auto.desc:
Appears when the type is Auto Segment. Rule Type sets the condition:
  • Spending — a minimum total spending (Minimum Total Belanja).
  • Purchase Frequency — a minimum number of purchases within a number of recent days.
  • Receivable Behavior — has an unpaid tab (receivable), or only tabs past the due date (overdue).
Changes to the conditions of the five built-in segments are reset by the system to their defaults.

submit.title: Simpan Segment (save)
submit.desc: Press Simpan Segment. A new segment appears in the segment list; saved changes open the segment's detail page. If the name is empty, red text appears under it. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

intro.title: Segment details
intro.desc: The page of one customer group: who is in it and how they got there. For a manual segment, this is where you add or remove members. Example: put all catering customers in a Catering Customers segment, then send them a promo through CRM Campaigns.

header.title: Name and type
header.desc: The segment name, its type (manual = filled by you, auto = filled by the system), and its description.

stats.title: Member counts
stats.desc:
• Total — all members.
  • Manual — added by hand.
  • Auto — added by the system because they meet the conditions.

members.title: Anggota Segment (segment members)
members.desc:
• Customer — name and phone number; press the name to open the customer's page.
  • Source — how they joined: manual or auto.
  • Matched — when they entered this segment.

row.title: Remove a member
row.desc: In a manual segment, the bin button at the right end of the row takes that customer out of the segment. The app asks Hapus Data? (delete data?) — press Ya, Hapus! (yes, delete): only the membership is removed; the customer stays and can be added again. Auto segments show no button (a dash): the system manages them. On a phone, swipe the table left.

empty.title: No members yet
empty.desc: This segment has no members yet. For a manual segment, add them with the Tambah Anggota Manual (add manual member) box. An auto segment fills itself when the system updates segments every night.

add.title: Tambah Anggota Manual (add member)
add.desc: Only on manual segments. Choose a customer from the list (name | phone | tier or non-member), then press Tambahkan ke Segment (add to segment). Repeat for other customers.

rule.title: Ringkasan Rule (rule summary)
rule.desc:
• Slug — the segment's technical name, made automatically from its name; no need to change it.
  • Rule Type — the condition of an auto segment: spending (total spending), purchase_frequency (how often they buy), receivable_behavior (unpaid tabs). A dash for manual segments.
  • Status — Aktif or Nonaktif (active/inactive).

intro.title: Voucher Customer (customer vouchers)
intro.desc: A voucher here is a personal discount coupon: for one specific customer, usable only once. Example: Mrs Sari's birthday gift — Rp 10,000 off a purchase of at least Rp 50,000. The cashier picks it on the cashier screen when Mrs Sari is chosen as the customer (she must be an active member). Start with Buat Voucher (create voucher).

add.title: Buat Voucher (create voucher)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new voucher: choose the customer, the discount, the minimum purchase, and how long it is valid. The voucher works at the outlet selected at the top of the screen when it is created.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a voucher code, voucher name, or customer name, then press Enter. Filter by status: Aktif (active), Terjadwal (scheduled), Expired, Sudah Dipakai (used), or Nonaktif (inactive).

list.title: Daftar Voucher (voucher list)
list.desc:
• Kode (code) — the voucher code (for example VCR-…) and its name.
  • Pelanggan (customer) — the owner and their phone number.
  • Benefit — the discount (percent or rupiah) and the Min. purchase.
  • Status — Aktif (usable), Terjadwal (not started yet), Expired (past its end date), Sudah Dipakai (used), or Nonaktif (switched off).
  • Kedaluwarsa (expiry) — the last moment it can be used.

row.title: Edit or delete a voucher
row.desc: At the right end of the row: the yellow pencil edits the voucher, the red bin deletes it. Deleting cannot be undone — to stop a voucher for a while, edit it and untick Voucher aktif (voucher active). On a phone, swipe the table left to see the buttons.

empty.title: No vouchers yet
empty.desc: No voucher matches. Clear the search and choose Semua Status (all statuses), or press Buat Voucher (create voucher).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

intro.title: Filling in a voucher
intro.desc: This form creates or edits one personal voucher. Required: customer, voucher name, and discount value. The code may be left empty — the system makes one. Once saved, the voucher appears on the cashier screen when that customer is chosen and the purchase meets its conditions.

customer.title: Pelanggan (customer, required)
customer.desc: Choose the voucher's owner. Each option shows the name, phone number, and tier/points — or non-member. Choose a customer who is a member: on the cashier screen the voucher box appears only for active members.

code.title: Kode Voucher (code, optional)
code.desc: The code the cashier will see, for example BDAYSARI. Letters turn into capitals automatically. Leave it empty to have one made for you, for example VCR-7K2M9QXA. The code must differ from every other voucher's.

name.title: Nama Voucher (name, required)
name.desc: An easy-to-understand name, for example Birthday Voucher. It appears with the code in the voucher choice on the cashier screen.

type.title: Tipe Diskon (discount type)
type.desc:
• Potongan Nominal (amount off) — takes a rupiah amount off the total, for example Rp 10,000.
  • Persentase (%) — takes a percentage off the total, for example 10%.
The voucher discount is applied after price promos.

value.title: Nilai Diskon (value, required)
value.desc: Type the number only: 10000 for Rp 10,000, or 10 for 10%. A percentage can be at most 100. The discount never exceeds the purchase total.

minimum.title: Minimum Belanja (minimum purchase)
minimum.desc: The voucher can only be used once the purchase (after promos) reaches this amount. Example: 50000 = at least Rp 50,000. Enter 0 for no minimum.

active.title: Voucher aktif (active)
active.desc: Tick it so the voucher can be used. Untick it to stop the voucher for a while without deleting it.

start.title: Mulai Berlaku (valid from, optional)
start.desc: The date and time the voucher can first be used. Leave empty to make it valid straight away. Until then its status is Terjadwal (scheduled).

end.title: Berakhir Pada (ends at, optional)
end.desc: The last moment it can be used, for example the end of this month. Leave empty for no time limit. After that its status is Expired and it no longer appears at the till. This date cannot be earlier than the start date.

notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
notes.desc: Notes for yourself, for example birthday gift or apology for a late order.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save). If something is missing, red text appears under it. After saving, you return to the voucher list. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Let the customer know they have a voucher. A quick way: create a CRM Campaign with Voucher Filter = Punya Voucher Aktif (has an active voucher), so the WhatsApp message goes only to customers with an active voucher.

intro.title: Customers Page
intro.desc: The list of your regular buyers: name, phone number, address, and member points. It is used when selling on credit (pay later / receivables), for collecting member points, and for sending WhatsApp messages. Buyers who pay on the spot need not be registered — the receipt shows them as Umum (walk-in).

actions.title: Top-right buttons
actions.desc:
• Tambah Pelanggan (add customer) — register one new customer.
  • Export — download all customers as an Excel file.
  • Import — add many customers at once from an Excel or CSV file. Its first row must hold the headings nama, telepon, alamat (name, phone, address). The file is sent as soon as you pick it; region and membership can be filled in later with Edit.
These buttons only appear for accounts allowed to add customers.

search.title: Search customers
search.desc: Type a name or a member code (starting with MEM-), then press Enter (on a phone: the search or ↵ key). Searching by phone number is not possible yet. Clear the box and press Enter to see everyone again.

view.title: Card or table view
view.desc: Switch between cards and a table. The content is the same; the table is more compact once you have many customers. When the page is reopened, it goes back to cards.

list.title: Customer list
list.desc:
• Name — press it to open the customer's detail page.
  • Member level label (tier): regular, silver, gold, or platinum — it follows their total spending. non-member means not in the points programme yet.
  • poin (points) — the member's points balance, which can be exchanged for a discount at the till.
  • Phone number and address.
The newest customer comes first.

row.title: Edit or Hapus (delete)
row.desc: Edit (pencil) opens the form to change the data. Hapus (bin, delete) asks Hapus Data? (delete data?) and then deletes for good. A customer who has already bought something cannot be deleted — their purchase history must stay intact. Use delete only for typos or duplicates.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.desc: No customers registered yet. Press Tambah Pelanggan (add customer), or add them straight from the cashier screen while serving — there, a name, phone number, and address are enough.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there are many customers, the list is split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and choose how many customers show at once (10, 25, or 50).

intro.title: Add or edit a customer
intro.desc: The form for one customer's details. Every field is required except the Member tick: name, phone number, province down to village, and address. Serving a buyer and in a hurry? Add them from the cashier screen instead — there, a name, phone number, and address are enough.

name.title: Nama Pelanggan (Name, required)
name.desc: A name the cashier will recognise, for example Mrs Siti Aminah or Mr Joko (garage). It appears when choosing a customer at the till and is printed on the receipt.

phone.title: No. Handphone (Mobile, required)
phone.desc: The customer's WhatsApp number, for example 081234567890. It is used when the shop sends WhatsApp messages, such as reminders or promotions. One number can belong to only one customer — if it is already registered, red text appears.

loyalty.title: Loyalty member (optional)
loyalty.desc:
• Tick Member when the customer joins the points programme. They get a member code automatically (MEM-…) and collect points on every purchase — by default 1 point per Rp 10,000 spent, changeable in the Loyalty menu.
  • Tier Awal (starting tier, the member level): choose Regular if unsure. After they shop, the tier adjusts itself to their total spending.
When editing, this box is titled Status Loyalty (loyalty status) and shows the member code and points.

region.title: Provinsi and Kota/Kabupaten (required)
region.desc: Choose the Provinsi (province) first, then the Kota/Kabupaten (city/regency). Each choice opens only after the one before it is filled. Changing the province clears the city, district, and village again.

area.title: Kecamatan and Kelurahan (required)
area.desc: Continue with the Kecamatan (district), then the Kelurahan (village/ward). The village matters: the Lokasi Terbanyak (top locations) box on the Dashboard counts sales by the customer's village, so you can see which area buys the most — handy for planning deliveries or promotions.

address.title: Alamat Detail (Address, required)
address.desc: Street name, house number, RT/RW, or a landmark. Example: Jl. Melati No. 5, RT 02/RW 03, opposite the mosque. Useful when delivering orders or collecting unpaid bills.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save; when editing: Simpan Perubahan, save changes). On success you return to the customer list. Missing or wrong fields are marked with red text — fix them and save again. Batal (cancel) returns without saving.

intro.title: Customer details
intro.desc: Everything about one customer on one page: member level, points, purchase history, vouchers, and groups. Open it before giving a discount or voucher, or to see how often they shop. To change the name or phone number, go back to the customer list and press Edit.

header.title: Name and member level
header.desc: Next to the name is the tier (member level) label: regular, silver, gold, or platinum — it follows total spending, with thresholds set in the Loyalty menu — or non-member. Below it are the phone number, address, and Member Code once they are a member.

points.title: Points and Jadikan Member
points.desc: The purple label shows the poin (points) balance. If they are not a member yet, there is a Jadikan Member (make member) button: one press makes them a member straight away, without asking again; they get a member code and start collecting points from their next purchase. You can undo it with Edit by unticking Member.

summary.title: Ringkasan Pelanggan (summary)
summary.desc:
• Total Transaksi — how many times they bought.
  • Total Belanja — the money spent across all purchases.
  • Member Sejak — the date they became a member.
  • Kunjungan Terakhir — the date of their last purchase.

segments.title: Segment Customer (groups)
segments.desc: A segment is a group of customers, for example High Spender or Inactive Customer (has not bought for a while). Labels marked auto are filled by the system every day using the segment rules; manual ones you choose yourself in the Tag Manual box. Segments are used to send a campaign (promotional message) to a particular group.

transactions.title: Transaksi Terakhir (recent sales)
transactions.desc: This customer's last five purchases: receipt number (invoice), date and time, and total. The full receipts can be found in the Transaction History menu.

rewards.title: Histori Reward (points history)
rewards.desc: The customer's points record: a green + number means points earned from a purchase, a red − number means points exchanged for a discount. Voucher use is recorded here too. The last 15 entries are shown.

info.title: Informasi (summary)
info.desc: A quick summary: Tier Loyalty (member level, or Belum menjadi member — not a member yet), Saldo Poin (points balance) that can be exchanged for a discount at the till, and Total Nilai Transaksi (total spent).

tags.title: Tag Manual (manual groups)
tags.desc: Tick the groups you made yourself for this customer (for example VIP Pelanggan), then press Simpan Segment (save segment). Groups are created first in the Customer Segments menu; if there are none, this box says Belum ada segment manual yang tersedia. (no manual segments available).

favorites.title: Produk Favorit (favourites)
favorites.desc: The three items this customer buys most, with quantities (for example x12 = 12 pieces). Handy for offering what they like or keeping it in stock.

vouchers.title: Voucher
vouchers.desc: Vouchers for this customer: code, name, and discount size (percent or rupiah). Vouchers are created in the Customer Vouchers menu and used at the till when they shop. This list also includes used or inactive vouchers — their status is shown in the Customer Vouchers menu.

intro.title: Fill in your store details
intro.desc: Just this one screen. After you press Daftarkan toko (register store), the app prepares your store (it takes a little while — progress is shown), then you are signed straight into your own store.

harga.title: Subscription fee
harga.desc: The fee is per selling outlet per month. The central warehouse and outlets that don't sell are free. There is no trial: the cashier becomes active once the first invoice is paid, by QRIS.

akun.title: Owner's Aishii account
akun.desc: The store will belong to the Aishii account shown here. Not yours? Press Keluar (sign out), then sign in with the right account.

nama_toko.title: Store name
nama_toko.desc: The name printed on receipts and shown in the app, for example Sumber Rejeki Store. You can change it later in Settings → Store Profile.

jenis_usaha.title: Business type
jenis_usaha.desc: Choose what best matches your business, such as a grocery shop, café, or restaurant. Starter item categories are prepared from this choice and can be changed any time.

nama.title: Your name
nama.desc: The owner's name. It is printed as Kasir (cashier) on receipts for sales you serve yourself, so write a person's name — not an email address.

email.title: Email
email.desc: The email address you will sign in with. One email can only own one store.

telepon.title: WhatsApp number (optional)
telepon.desc: Your store's phone number, for example 081234567890. It becomes the store number in Settings → Store Profile — the one shown on receipts — and can be changed any time.

sandi.title: Password
sandi.desc: At least 8 characters, then repeat it in the next box. Use a password you don't use anywhere else.

kirim.title: Register store
kirim.desc: Press it once, then wait. The next page shows the store being prepared step by step — don't close it until it finishes.

intro.title: Register a store
intro.desc: Here you create your own store on Aishii POS. The store belongs to your Aishii account — one account for every Aishii product. This guide shows you the right door.

harga.title: Subscription fee
harga.desc: The fee is per selling outlet (a place that uses the cashier screen) per month. The central warehouse and outlets that don't sell are free. There is no trial: the cashier becomes active once the first invoice is paid, by QRIS.

buat_akun.title: No Aishii account yet
buat_akun.desc: Press Buat akun Aishii — gratis (create a free Aishii account). Enter your email and a password, then open the confirmation email sent to your inbox. Once confirmed, you come back here to name your store.

sudah_punya.title: Already have an Aishii account
sudah_punya.desc: Already using Aishii Bazar or another Aishii product? Press Sudah punya akun Aishii? Masuk (already have an account? sign in), sign in with it, and you come back here to fill in your store details.

intro.title: Welcome to Aishii POS
intro.desc:
This is the Dashboard — a summary of your store. This short guide shows where the important parts are.

Press Next to continue, Previous to go back, or × to close. Every page has its own guide, so there is no need to memorise everything now.

menu.title: Main menu
menu.desc:
Every page is in this menu, grouped by task:
  • Master Data — categories, products, customers, suppliers.
  • Sales — the cashier screen, history, returns, and receivables (customer debts).
  • Inventory and Procurement — warehouse stock and buying from suppliers.
  • Reports, Operations, and Settings further down — scroll the menu.
You only see the menus you are allowed to open.

toggle.title: Menu button (☰)
toggle.desc: On a phone the main menu is hidden — press this button to open it, then pick a page. On a wide screen this button shrinks the menu to give you more room.

new_sale.title: Transaksi Baru (New Transaction)
new_sale.desc: A shortcut to the cashier screen to start selling. If no cashier shift is open yet, you will be asked to open one first.

checklist.title: Store Setup Checklist
checklist.desc: The steps to get the store ready to sell: complete the store profile, create a category, add a product, register a customer, then finish the first transaction. Tap an unticked step to go straight to its page. This box disappears once every step is done.

stats.title: Today's figures
stats.desc:
• Penjualan Hari Ini (today's sales) — total money from today's sales.
  • Profit Hari Ini (today's profit) — selling price minus purchase (cost) price of the items sold.
  • Target Bulan Ini (this month's target) — how far this month's sales are from the target. Set the target in Settings → Sales Target; until then it shows 0%.
  • Transaksi Hari Ini (today's transactions) — how many sales you made today.

info.title: Record counts
info.desc: How many categories, products, transactions, and customers this store has recorded since the start.

chart.title: Tren Pendapatan (Revenue Trend)
chart.desc: A revenue chart to see sales going up and down. Point at or tap a dot to see its amount. An empty chart means there are no sales yet.

widgets.title: Quick watch
widgets.desc:
• Shift Aktif (active shifts) — cashiers at work and the money that should be in their drawer.
  • Produk Terlaris (best sellers) — the items sold the most.
  • Slow Moving — items not sold for 30 days; consider a promotion.
  • Pelanggan Terbaik (top customers) — the customers who buy most often.
  • Lokasi Terbanyak (top locations) — the neighbourhoods most customers come from.

recent.title: Transaksi Terbaru (Recent Transactions)
recent.desc: The last five sales: invoice number, date, customer, and total. The full list is in Transaction History.

lowstock.title: Stok Menipis (Low Stock)
lowstock.desc: Items with fewer than 10 left. Restock from your supplier soon (Purchase Orders menu) so you do not run out when customers come.

outlet.title: Choose an outlet
outlet.desc: If the store has several branches (outlets), choose the one you are working on here. The sales and stock you see follow the selected branch.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.desc: This bell tells you what needs attention, such as low stock, customer receivables, or supplier payables that are almost due. The red number shows new notifications.

help.title: Guide button (?)
help.desc: Press the ? button at any time to open the guide for the page you are on. Every page — Products, Cashier, Reports, Settings, and more — has its own guide.

account.title: Account menu
account.desc: The circle with your initial. It holds Profile (change name, photo, password), Replay Guided Tours (shows every guide again), and Log out. On a phone, it also holds Guided Tour and the language choice.

next.title: Next steps
next.desc:
New store? The suggested order:
  1. Settings → Store Profile: name, address, logo for receipts.
  2. Categories: groups of items, for example Drinks and Food.
  3. Products: the items you sell with their prices and stock.
  4. Transaksi Baru (New Transaction): open a shift, then start selling.

intro.title: Area Dine-In (dine-in areas)
intro.desc:
Areas are groups of tables in your eating space, for example Indoor, Terrace, or 2nd Floor. Use this page if you serve dine-in customers with a QR menu: customers scan the QR code on their table and order from their own phone.

Start by creating your areas here, then add the tables in the Dine-In Tables menu.

add.title: Tambah Area (add area)
add.desc:
Press Tambah Area (add area) to open the form:
  • Nama Area (area name, required) — for example Terrace.
  • Urutan (order) — display order; lower numbers come first. You can leave it as is.
  • Area aktif (area active) — leave it ticked.
Press Simpan (save). The new area belongs to the outlet currently selected in the top bar.

list.title: Data Area (area list)
list.desc:
All areas of this outlet:
  • Nama Area (area name) — the name of the table group.
  • Jumlah Meja (tables) — how many tables are in the area.
  • Status — Aktif (active) or Nonaktif (inactive). This is only a label: orders from its tables still come in. To stop orders from a table, deactivate that table in Dine-In Tables.

row.title: Edit or delete an area
row.desc:
• Pencil (yellow) — opens the same form to change the name, order, or status; save with Perbarui (update).
  • Bin (red) — deletes the area after you press OK on the confirmation question. This cannot be undone.
An area that still has tables cannot be deleted and stays in the list — move or delete its tables first.

empty.title: No areas yet
empty.desc: This outlet has no areas yet. Press Tambah Area (add area) and create at least one, for example Main Area — every table will later be placed in an area.

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Open the Dine-In Tables menu: add tables to each area, then download and print each table's QR code and stick it on that table. Customer orders will then arrive in the Dine-In Orders menu.

intro.title: Order from your table
intro.desc:
Welcome! On this page you order straight from your table:
  1. Pick dishes and press + Tambah (add).
  2. Press the order button at the bottom.
  3. Press Pesan — Bayar di Kasir (order — pay at the counter).
You pay at the cashier.

header.title: Your place and table
header.desc: The name of the place and your table number. Make sure the table is right so your order reaches you.

categories.title: Menu categories
categories.desc: Press a category name, for example Minuman (drinks), to see only that group. Semua (all) shows the whole menu.

list.title: Choose dishes
list.desc: Press + Tambah (add) on the dish you want. Then − and + buttons appear to change the quantity.

cart.title: Your order
cart.desc: The number of items and the total show here. Press it to review the order, add a note (for example not spicy), then press Pesan — Bayar di Kasir (order — pay at the counter).

intro.title: Pesanan Dine-In (dine-in orders)
intro.desc:
Orders that customers send from the QR menu on their table arrive here. The staff's job: check the order, then press Terima (accept) or Tolak (reject). The customer sees the answer on their phone. All orders are paid at the cashier — online payment is not available.

This page does not refresh by itself: reload it regularly while you are open to see new orders.

card.title: One box, one order
card.desc: At the top: the table name. In the middle: the items ordered as quantity × price, and the customer's Catatan (note) if any, for example not spicy. At the bottom: the order time and the Total to pay.

status.title: Order status
status.desc:
• Menunggu (waiting, yellow) — a new order the staff has not answered yet.
  • Diterima (accepted, purple) — accepted and recorded as a sale; the customer is asked to pay at the cashier. It stays on this page.
The small line below shows the number of items, the subtotal, and the payment method Bayar di Kasir (pay at the cashier). Rejected orders disappear from the list.

actions.title: Accept or reject
actions.desc:
• Terima (accept) — the order is recorded straight away as a sale in your name and the stock goes down. It only works when your cashier shift is open at the table's outlet and there is enough stock. If you see Gagal menerima pesanan (failed to accept), open a shift first in the Transactions menu.
  • Tolak (reject) — you may type a reason (optional). The order disappears from the list and the customer sees Ditolak (rejected).
Neither can be undone.

empty.title: No orders
empty.desc: No orders are waiting. New orders appear here after a customer scans the QR code on a table and presses Pesan — Bayar di Kasir (order — pay at the cashier). No QR codes yet? Create the tables in the Dine-In Tables menu.

intro.title: Meja Dine-In (dine-in tables)
intro.desc:
Every table here has its own QR code to print and stick on the table. Customers scan it with their phone camera, your menu opens, they choose food and press Pesan — Bayar di Kasir (order — pay at the cashier). The order arrives in the Dine-In Orders menu.

Online payment through the QR menu is not available: customers always pay at the cashier. Create areas in Dine-In Areas first, then add the tables here.

add.title: Tambah Meja (add table)
add.desc:
Press Tambah Meja (add table), then fill in:
  • Nama Meja (table name, required) — for example M1; it shows on the customer menu and on orders.
  • Area — choose the area. Tables with Tanpa Area (no area) do not appear on this page, so always pick one.
  • Kapasitas (capacity) — number of seats, for example 4.
  • Bentuk (shape) — square or round on the map.
  • Meja aktif (table active) — leave it ticked; an inactive table's QR cannot be used to order.
Press Simpan (save). New tables appear in the top-left corner of the map.

areas.title: Filter by area
areas.desc: Press an area name to show only that area's tables — on the map and in the list. Semua (all) shows every table again.

map.title: Table map
map.desc: A floor plan of your tables. Each square or circle is one table with its name: purple = active, grey = inactive. Tap a table to open its edit form. There you can change its name, area, capacity, shape, and position: Posisi X = column from the left (0–24), Posisi Y = row from the top (0–14). Save with Perbarui (update).

to_list.title: Daftar (list) view
to_list.desc: The Daftar (list) button swaps the map for a table of all your tables — that is where each table's QR code download button is. Press Next and the guide opens the list view for you.

list.title: Daftar Meja (table list)
list.desc:
One row per table:
  • Meja (table) — the table name; the small mark in front shows its shape.
  • Area — the area it belongs to.
  • Kapasitas (capacity) — number of seats (org = people).
  • Status — Aktif (active: its QR can be used to order) or Nonaktif (inactive).

row.title: QR code, edit, delete
row.desc:
• Download arrow (grey) — opens the table's QR code image in a new tab. Save or print it and stick it on that table. Every table has its own code, so don't mix them up.
  • Pencil (yellow) — edits the table. You can also tap the table on the map.
  • Bin (red) — deletes the table after confirmation. This cannot be undone, and its printed QR code stops working.

empty.title: No tables yet
empty.desc: There are no tables here yet. Press Tambah Meja (add table) to create the first one — make sure its area exists in Dine-In Areas.

to_map.title: Back to the map
to_map.desc: The Peta (map) button shows the floor plan again.

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Once the QR codes are on the tables, try scanning one with your phone camera: your store's menu should open. Customer orders will then appear in the Dine-In Orders menu.

intro.title: Approval Diskon (Discount Approval)
intro.desc:
When a cashier gives a manual discount above the store's limit (in rupiah or percent), the sale is still saved but waits for approval. The owner or a supervisor checks it here and approves or rejects it. Example: the limit is Rp 50,000 and the cashier gives a Rp 75,000 discount.

Approval is only requested when a discount limit has been set for your store; without a limit, every discount applies immediately.

card.title: Sales waiting for approval
card.desc: Each box is one sale: the invoice number, the Kasir (cashier) who gave the discount, the Pelanggan (customer), the Diskon (discount, red), and the Total after the discount. The eye icon opens the receipt to see what was bought. While it waits, a cash sale is not yet counted in the shift's drawer cash.

actions.title: Setujui or Tolak (approve or reject)
actions.desc:
• Setujui (approve) — the discount stands. A cash sale becomes Lunas (paid), a pay-later sale stays Belum Lunas (unpaid), and other methods wait for their payment.
  • Tolak (reject) — the discount is cancelled: the total goes back up by the discount and the sale is marked unpaid; the difference has to be collected from the customer.
A confirmation box appears first. The decision cannot be changed.

empty.title: Nothing waiting
empty.desc: Semua transaksi sudah diverifikasi (all transactions verified) — no discount is waiting for approval. New sales with a discount above the limit will appear here, so check this page regularly.

intro.title: Goods Receiving
intro.desc: A record of goods that have arrived from suppliers. Each receiving (GR, short for Goods Receiving) adds stock to its PO's destination warehouse. Example: the wholesaler delivers the 10 cases of water you ordered yesterday — record them here so the stock goes up. Start by pressing Terima Barang (receive goods).

add.title: Terima Barang (receive goods)
add.desc: Opens the form to record a delivery. Goods can only be received against a PO that has been ordered (status Dipesan or Sebagian Diterima). No PO yet? Create one in the Purchase Orders menu first. This button appears if you are allowed to record receivings.

search.title: Search receivings
search.desc: Type a receiving number, for example GR-20261015-0001, to find it. The list updates as you type.

list.title: Receiving list
list.desc: Each row is one delivery: Dokumen (GR number), PO Referensi (the PO it belongs to — press to open it), Supplier, Tanggal Terima (date received), and Diterima Oleh (received by). A recorded receiving cannot be edited or deleted.

row.title: Open a receiving
row.desc: Press the eye button at the right end of the row to see which items arrived and how many. On a phone, swipe the table left first.

empty.title: No receivings yet
empty.desc: No deliveries recorded yet, or your search found nothing. When a supplier's delivery arrives, press Terima Barang (receive goods).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many receivings are split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

intro.title: Terima Barang (receive goods)
intro.desc: The form to record a supplier delivery. First count the goods that actually arrived, then fill them in here. Once confirmed, stock goes up straight away and the receiving cannot be changed.

po.title: Pilih Purchase Order (choose the PO)
po.desc: Choose the PO this delivery belongs to — shown as PO number and supplier name. Only POs that are Dipesan (ordered) or Sebagian Diterima (partly received) appear; a Draft PO first needs Pesan ke Supplier (order from supplier) on its PO page. Once a PO is chosen, its items appear below — open this guide again for help with that part.

items.title: Item Diterima (items received)
items.desc:
One row for each PO item not yet complete:
  • Qty PO — how many were ordered.
  • Sudah Diterima (already received) — what came in earlier deliveries.
  • Sisa (remaining) — what has not arrived yet.
  • Qty Diterima (qty received) — type how many actually arrived today. It starts at the remaining amount and cannot go above it. Not arrived? Type 0 — that row is skipped.
  • Catatan (note, optional) — for example 2 boxes dented.

notes.title: Catatan Penerimaan (delivery note, optional)
notes.desc: A note for the whole delivery, for example Delivered by driver Budi, delivery note no. 123. It shows on the receiving's detail page.

submit.title: Konfirmasi Penerimaan (confirm receiving)
submit.desc:
Check the quantities, then press Konfirmasi Penerimaan. What happens:
  • Stock goes up in the PO's destination warehouse and is logged in Stock Mutations (the stock in/out record).
  • The PO becomes Selesai (completed) if everything has arrived, otherwise Sebagian Diterima (partly received).
  • If the PO has a supplier, the debt is recorded in Supplier Payables, due in 30 days.
It cannot be cancelled or edited. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

next.title: After confirming
next.desc:
The receiving's detail page opens. Next:
  • Damaged or wrong goods? Send them back with Supplier Returns.
  • Pay the bill in Supplier Payables.
  • PO items that have not arrived yet can be received later with this form again.

intro.title: Goods receiving details
intro.desc: The record of one delivery: which items arrived, how many, when, and who received them. This page is view-only — a recorded receiving cannot be edited or deleted.

header.title: Receiving number
header.desc: The receiving number (GR-date-sequence), made automatically. Below it: PO Referensi (reference PO — press to open it), the supplier, who received it, and when. Kembali ke daftar penerimaan (back to the list) takes you to the list.

items.title: Item Diterima (items received)
items.desc:
• Qty Diterima (qty received) — the amount added to stock with this delivery.
  • Harga Satuan (unit price) — the purchase price from the PO.
  • Subtotal — Qty × price, the value of the goods received.
  • Catatan (note) — remarks per item made when receiving.
On a phone, swipe the table left to see every column.

info.title: Informasi (summary)
info.desc: A summary: number, PO Referensi (reference PO), Tanggal Terima (date received), and Diterima Oleh (received by). If the delivery had a note, a Catatan (note) box appears above it.

next.title: Next steps
next.desc:
• Damaged, expired, or wrong goods? Create a Supplier Return to send them back — the stock will go down.
  • Pay the bill in Supplier Payables.
  • Wrong amount recorded? A receiving cannot be edited; correct the stock count with Stock Opname (a stock recount).

intro.title: Langganan (Subscription)
intro.desc: Aishii POS is paid monthly: the price is per selling outlet per month, shown under the title (for example Rp 25,000). Here you see until when the subscription is active and create a bill to pay it. When it runs out, the cashier stops and data cannot be changed, but reports stay readable and nothing is deleted.

status.title: Subscription status
status.desc:
• Green tick Aktif sampai (active until) — the end date and the Sisa (remaining) days.
  • Red lock Berakhir (ended) or Belum aktif (not active yet) — the cashier stops until a bill is paid. There is no free trial.
  • Outlet berjualan (selling outlets) — how many outlets are selling, and how many are paid for.
A yellow box means payments are checked manually by the service team for now, usually within a few hours.

buat_tagihan.title: Creating a bill
buat_tagihan.desc: This box appears for the store owner when no bill is waiting. Its title is Tagihan pertama (first bill) for a store that has never paid, otherwise Perpanjang atau tambah outlet (extend or add outlets). Set its contents in the next steps, then create the bill.

jenis.title: Perpanjang or Tambah outlet
jenis.desc:
• Perpanjang (extend) — adds months to the active period. If paid before it ends, the months count from the old end date, so no days are lost.
  • Tambah outlet (add outlet) — pays for extra outlets for the rest of the current period only: charged per day (price ÷ 30 × days left), rounded up to the thousand. The end date does not move.
This choice exists only while the subscription is active.

bulan.title: Lama berlangganan (length)
bulan.desc: Choose 1, 3, 6, or 12 bln (months). The monthly price is the same for every choice (no discount), so pick what suits your cash flow.

jumlah.title: Number of outlets
jumlah.desc: Press − or + to set the number of outlets. When extending, it is at least the number of outlets currently selling. Want to pay for fewer? First stop sales at an outlet you don't use (the Berhenti jual button below). For Tambah outlet, enter only the extra outlets.

buat.title: Buat tagihan (create bill)
buat.desc: This button shows the total to be billed, for example Buat tagihan Rp 75.000 for 1 outlet × 3 months. Press it to create the bill; how to pay then appears on this page. Only one bill can be waiting at a time.

tagihan.title: Bill awaiting payment
tagihan.desc: A bill that has been created but not paid yet: what it is for (for example 1 outlet × 3 bulan, 3 months) and its deadline (berlaku sampai, valid until). Pay before then; after that it expires and you need to create a new one.

nominal.title: Transfer TEPAT sebesar (exact amount)
nominal.desc: The amount to pay, exactly down to the last digit. The final digits are a kode unik (unique code) that lets your payment be recognised automatically — don't round it. Press Salin nominal (copy amount) to copy the number, then paste it in your payment app. If it says automatic confirmation is not available yet, send the payment proof via WhatsApp.

qris.title: Pay with QRIS
qris.desc: Open your bank or e-wallet app (mobile banking, GoPay, OVO, DANA, and so on), choose pay/scan QRIS, and point the camera at this code. Type the amount yourself, exactly as shown above. Make sure the recipient name matches the one written under the code.

periksa.title: After paying
periksa.desc: Press Saya sudah bayar — periksa (I've paid — check). Payments are usually picked up within a minute or two, and while a bill is waiting this page also checks by itself every so often. If it takes long, press Kirim bukti lewat WhatsApp (send proof via WhatsApp) — the message is ready, just attach a photo of the transfer receipt.

batal.title: Cancel the bill
batal.desc: Batalkan dan buat tagihan lain (cancel and create another bill) is for a wrong bill, for example the wrong number of months. Do not cancel it if you have already paid. Only the store owner sees this button.

pemilik.title: Managed by the owner
pemilik.desc: Only the store owner can create or cancel bills — that is why this box says Langganan diatur pemilik toko (the subscription is managed by the store owner). Other accounts can still see the status here, for example to understand why the cashier has stopped.

outlet.title: Outlet yang ditagih (billed outlets)
outlet.desc: The outlets that are currently selling — these are what the bill counts. The central warehouse and non-selling outlets are free. With more than one outlet, the owner sees a Berhenti jual (stop selling) button: that outlet is no longer billed and its cashier can't sell. To switch it back on, open the Outlet menu and tick Outlet melayani penjualan (outlet serves sales).

riwayat.title: Riwayat tagihan (bill history)
riwayat.desc: The last twelve bills: amount, bill number, and contents. Status: Lunas (paid) with the payment date, Dibatalkan (cancelled), or Kedaluwarsa (expired — not paid before its deadline).

intro.title: Sign in
intro.desc: Sign in with your account email and password. The owner's account is created when the app is first set up; cashier accounts are created by the owner under Users.

email.title: Email
email.desc: Type your account email, for example name@yourshop.com.

password.title: Password
password.desc: Type your password. Press the eye icon on the right to see what you typed if you think you made a typo.

remember.title: Remember me
remember.desc: Tick Remember me on your own phone or computer so you don't have to sign in every time. Don't tick it on a shared or borrowed device. Lupa kata sandi? (forgot password) emails you a link to set a new one. A cashier who forgot the password can also ask the store owner to change it under Users.

submit.title: Sign in
submit.desc: Press Masuk (sign in). If a red message says the email or password is wrong, check the spelling and try again. After several wrong attempts, wait a moment before trying again.

intro.title: Two ways to sign in
intro.desc:
This page has two doors, depending on who you are:
  • Store owner — sign in with your Aishii account (the same account for Aishii Bazar and other Aishii products).
  • Cashier — sign in with the email and password the store owner created for you.

aishii.title: Store owner: Aishii account
aishii.desc: Press Masuk dengan akun Aishii (sign in with Aishii account). You go to aishiierp.com to enter your Aishii email and password, then come straight back to your store. Your Aishii password is not typed in the boxes below.

email.title: Cashier: email
email.desc: Type your cashier account email, for example kasir1@yourshop.com. Cashier accounts are created by the store owner under Users — ask the owner for it.

password.title: Password
password.desc: Type the cashier account password. Press the eye icon on the right to see what you typed if you think you made a typo.

remember.title: Remember me
remember.desc: Tick Remember me on your own phone or computer so you don't have to sign in every time. Don't tick it on a shared or borrowed device. Lupa kata sandi? (forgot password) emails you a link to set a new one. A cashier who forgot the password can also ask the store owner to change it under Users.

submit.title: Sign in
submit.desc: Press Masuk (sign in). If a red message says the email or password is wrong, check the spelling. Store owners who see that message: use the Masuk dengan akun Aishii button above.

daftar.title: No store yet?
daftar.desc: Press Daftarkan toko (register a store) to create a new store on Aishii POS. Sign-up uses an Aishii account; if you don't have one yet, you can create it for free along the way.

intro.title: Members Page
intro.desc: Members are regular customers who join the points programme. Every purchase earns them points they can later trade for a discount at the till. Example: Mrs Sari, who buys coffee every morning — make her a member so her points add up and she keeps coming back. Members are still listed under Customers; this page shows only those who are members. Start with Daftarkan Member (register member).

add.title: Daftarkan Member (register)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new member: name, phone number, and address. The member number (for example MEM-AB12CD34) is created automatically. People already listed under Customers need not be registered again — make them members with the Jadikan Member (make member) button on their customer page.

summary.title: Member summary
summary.desc:
• Total Member — everyone ever registered, including deactivated members.
  • Member Aktif (active members) — still earning points and member benefits.
  • Omzet Member (member revenue) — the total value of purchases by customers who are members.
  • Repeat Rate — the share of members who have bought more than once. Below it, Top member is the member with the highest total spending.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a member's name or member number — the list filters as you type. Pick a Tier to see one level only, for example just Gold. Status options: Member Aktif (active — the default view), Member Nonaktif (inactive), or Semua Status (all).

list.title: Daftar Member (member list)
list.desc:
• Member — name, member number, and phone number.
  • Tier — the member level: regular, silver, gold, or platinum. It rises automatically with total spending (thresholds in Settings → Loyalty). Below it: Aktif or Nonaktif (active/inactive).
  • Poin (points) — the balance that can be redeemed.
  • Total Belanja (total spending) and Transaksi (transactions) — how much and how often they buy.
  • Terakhir Belanja (last purchase) — the date of their latest purchase.

row.title: Open or edit a member
row.desc: Press a member's name to open their details: purchases, points, vouchers, and segments. The yellow pencil button at the right end of the row opens the edit form. On a phone, swipe the table left to see the other columns. Members cannot be deleted here — to stop their benefits, set them to inactive.

top.title: Top Member by Spending
top.desc: The member with the highest total spending, and the amount. Customers like this deserve a thank-you, for example a personal voucher from the Customer Vouchers menu.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

empty.title: No members yet
empty.desc: No member matches the search or filters. Clear the search box or choose Semua Status (all statuses). New store? Press Daftarkan Member (register member) for your first member.

help.title: Other ways to make a member
help.desc:
Besides this page, a customer can become a member:
  • on the cashier screen — select the customer, then press Upgrade member;
  • in the Customers menu — open the customer's page, then press Jadikan Member (make member).
Their purchase history stays linked, and a member number is created straight away.

next.title: Next steps
next.desc:
1. Settings → Loyalty: set the points rules — by default 1 point per Rp 10,000 spent, and 1 point is worth a Rp 100 discount when redeemed. Each tier's spending threshold is there too.
  2. Price Promos: create member-only prices (choose Scope Member Loyalty).
  3. Customer Vouchers: give personal vouchers to specific members.

intro.title: Filling in a member
intro.desc: Here you register a new member or edit one. Required: name, phone number, region (province down to village), and address. After saving, a new member gets a member number automatically and starts collecting points from their next purchase. Example: register Mr Budi, a customer who buys groceries every week.

info.title: Cara kerja member (how it works)
info.desc:
This box sums up member benefits:
  • pricing khusus member — promo prices for members only (created in Price Promos);
  • earn/redeem poin — earning points when buying and trading them for a discount; the rules are in Settings → Loyalty;
  • voucher personal — a voucher for one person only (Customer Vouchers menu).

name.title: Nama Member (name, required)
name.desc: The customer's full name, for example Budi Santoso. It is shown on the cashier screen when the cashier chooses a customer.

phone.title: No. Handphone (phone, required)
