phone.desc: An active mobile number, for example 081234567890. The cashier can search for the customer by this number, and it is used for WhatsApp messages from CRM Campaigns. One number belongs to one customer only — if it is rejected as already taken, the person is already under Customers; make them a member from there.

status.title: Status Member
status.desc: Tick Aktif (active) so this person earns points, gets member prices, and can use vouchers at the till. Untick it to stop member benefits without deleting their purchase history and points. When registering a new member, leave it ticked.

tier.title: Tier Member (optional)
tier.desc: The member level: Regular, Silver, Gold, or Platinum — used for promos aimed at certain levels. The tier is recalculated automatically from total spending every time the member buys, so a choice made here may change again. Thresholds are in Settings → Loyalty (default: Silver from Rp 500,000, Gold Rp 1,500,000, Platinum Rp 3,000,000). New members can stay Regular.

region.title: Wilayah & Alamat (region & address, required)
region.desc: Choose in order: Provinsi (province) → Kota/Kabupaten (city/regency) → Kecamatan (district) → Kelurahan (village). Each box opens only after the one before it is filled. Then type the Alamat Detail (street address), for example Jl. Melati No. 21, RT 02/RW 05. The region is used on the dashboard to show where most of your customers come from.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Daftarkan Member (register member), or Simpan Perubahan (save changes) when editing. If something is missing, red text appears under that field. A new member then appears in the member list; saved changes open the member's page. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

intro.title: Member details
intro.desc: Everything about one member on one screen: their purchases, points, vouchers, and the groups (segments) they belong to. Open this page when a customer asks about their points, or before offering them a promo that suits them.

header.title: Member identity
header.desc: Name, tier (level: regular, silver, gold, platinum), and status: green Aktif (active) means they still earn points and member benefits; grey Nonaktif (inactive) means the benefits are stopped. Below are the phone number, address, and Nomor Anggota (member number, for example MEM-…).

actions.title: Points and Edit Member
actions.desc: The purple label shows the current points balance. Press Edit Member to change their details or tier, or to deactivate the member.

summary.title: Ringkasan Member (summary)
summary.desc:
• Total Transaksi (transactions) — how many times they bought.
  • Total Belanja (total spending) — the money from all their purchases.
  • Member Sejak (member since) — the date they became a member.
  • Kunjungan Terakhir (last visit) — the date of their latest purchase.

transactions.title: Transaksi Member (purchases)
transactions.desc: The last five purchases: receipt number (invoice), date and time, and total. The full history is in the Transaction History menu.

rewards.title: Histori Reward (points history)
rewards.desc: Points in and out, newest first: a green + number means points earned from a purchase, a red − number means points redeemed for a discount. Voucher use is recorded here too (0 points). Each line's title is the receipt number of the transaction.

info.title: Informasi Member (information)
info.desc: Three key figures at once: Tier Loyalty (level), Saldo Poin (points balance that can be redeemed at the till; by default 1 point = Rp 100 off), and Total Nilai Transaksi (total spending).

segments.title: Segment Terkait (segments)
segments.desc: A segment is a group of customers, for example VIP Pelanggan or High Spender. A MANUAL label means you put them in that group yourself; AUTO means the system added them because they meet its conditions. Segments are used to choose who receives messages in CRM Campaigns.

favorites.title: Produk Favorit (favourites)
favorites.desc: The three products they buy most, with quantities (for example Kopi Susu x12). Handy for offering them the right promo.

vouchers.title: Voucher Member (vouchers)
vouchers.desc: This member's personal vouchers: code, voucher name, and value (percent or rupiah). The list also shows used or expired vouchers — their status is in the Customer Vouchers menu. A voucher is used at the till when this member is chosen as the customer.

intro.title: Supplier Payables
intro.desc: The money you still owe suppliers. A debt is recorded automatically when goods from a PO with a supplier are received (due in 30 days), or you record one yourself with the form at the top. Example: the wholesaler delivers goods worth Rp 754,000 that you may pay at the end of the month. Open a debt to record a payment.

form.title: Record a debt by hand
form.desc: This form records a debt that does not come from a PO — for example goods bought on credit by phone, or an old debt from before you used the app. Debts from Goods Receiving are recorded automatically, so don't record them twice.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.desc: Choose the supplier you owe. Umum (general) means no particular supplier.

number.title: Nomor Dokumen (document number, optional)
number.desc: Type the supplier's invoice or receipt number so it is easy to match, for example INV-AGEN-0912. Left empty? A number starting with INV- is made automatically.

total.title: Total (required)
total.desc: The amount owed in rupiah, digits only without dots — for example type 1500000 for Rp 1,500,000.

due.title: Jatuh Tempo (due date, optional)
due.desc: The last day to pay the debt. Best filled in: the notification bell reminds you of debts due within 3 days or already overdue, and the status becomes Jatuh Tempo (overdue) once the date has passed.

note.title: Catatan (note, optional)
note.desc: Extra notes, for example Gas and rice purchase, paid in 2 instalments. On a phone, fill this in before pressing Simpan (save) — the box is below the button.

save.title: Simpan (save)
save.desc: Press Simpan to record the debt with the status Belum Lunas (unpaid). A recorded debt cannot be edited or deleted, so check the amount first.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a document number, choose a supplier or status, then press Terapkan (apply) to filter the list.

list.title: Debt list
list.desc:
Each row is one debt: Dokumen (receiving or invoice number), Supplier, Total, Sisa (remaining) still unpaid, Jatuh Tempo (due date), and Status:
  • Belum Lunas (unpaid) — nothing paid yet.
  • Parsial (partial) — partly paid.
  • Lunas (paid) — fully paid.
  • Jatuh Tempo (overdue) — past the due date and not fully paid; pay soon.

row.title: Open a debt
row.desc: Press the row (on a phone: the card) to open that debt — there you see its payment history and record new payments.

empty.title: No debts yet
empty.desc: No supplier debts yet, or none match your filters. Debts appear by themselves after goods from a PO with a supplier are received.

intro.title: Debt details
intro.desc: The page for one supplier debt: the total, how much has been paid, what is left, and the payment history. Each time you pay the supplier — cash or transfer, in full or in instalments — record it here so the balance stays correct.

header.title: Number and status
header.desc: The debt's document number and status: Belum Lunas (unpaid), Parsial (partly paid), Lunas (paid), or Jatuh Tempo (overdue). Kembali (back) takes you to the debt list.

supplier.title: Supplier and due date
supplier.desc: The supplier's name (and phone number, if any) and the Jatuh Tempo (due date) — the deadline to pay in full. Debts from goods receiving are due 30 days after the goods arrived.

summary.title: Total, paid, remaining
summary.desc:
• Total — the whole bill.
  • Terbayar (paid) — the sum of all payments recorded.
  • Sisa (remaining) — what you still have to pay.

add.title: Tambah Pembayaran (add payment)
add.desc: Press to open the payment form in the Detail Hutang (debt details) box (on a phone it is further down — scroll down). Fill in the amount, date, and method, then save. Recording a payment does not move any money — you still pay the supplier yourself. This button appears while the debt is not fully paid and you are allowed to record payments.

history.title: Riwayat Pembayaran (payment history)
history.desc: Every payment recorded: amount, date, method (cash or bank_transfer), bank name, note, and who recorded it. A recorded payment cannot be edited or deleted.

amount.title: Nominal (amount)
amount.desc: The amount paid this time, digits only — for example type 250000. It may be part of the debt (an instalment) but cannot be more than the Sisa (remaining).

date.title: Tanggal Bayar (payment date)
date.desc: The date the money was given to the supplier. It starts as today; change it when recording an earlier payment.

method.title: Tunai or Transfer (cash or transfer)
method.desc: Choose Tunai (cash) when paid in cash, or Transfer when paid through the bank.

bank.title: Rekening (bank account)
bank.desc: Appears when you choose Transfer: pick the store account the transfer was made from (optional). Accounts are set up in the Bank Accounts menu.

note.title: Catatan (note, optional)
note.desc: A note about the payment, for example 2nd instalment, handed to the supplier's driver.

save.title: Simpan Pembayaran (save payment)
save.desc: Press Simpan Pembayaran. The payment joins the history, Terbayar (paid) and Sisa (remaining) are updated, and the status becomes Lunas (paid) when nothing is left — otherwise Parsial (partial), or Jatuh Tempo (overdue) if the due date has passed. It cannot be edited or deleted, so check the amount first.

preview.title: Preview / PDF
preview.desc: Opens a preview of the debt summary: your store details, the supplier, total, balance, and payment history. In that window, PDF / Cetak (PDF / print) opens a PDF in a new tab to print or save, and Tutup (close) closes it.

intro.title: Hak Akses (permissions)
intro.desc:
A list of every permission in the app. One permission = the right to do one thing, for example open the Products page or delete a customer. This page is for viewing only — permissions are not handed out here.

How to give them: bundle permissions into an Access Group, then choose that group for an employee in the Users menu.

search.title: Search permissions
search.desc: Type part of a name and press Enter, for example products to see every product permission.

list.title: How to read the names
list.desc:
Names are written menu-action:
  • -access — may open and view that menu.
  • -create — may add new data.
  • -edit or -update — may change data.
  • -delete — may delete data.
Example: products-access + products-create = may view and add products, but not change or delete them.

item.title: Other endings
item.desc:
• -import / -export — bring data in / download it with Excel.
  • -pay — record a payment of a receivable or payable.
  • -open, -close, -force-close — open, close, and force-close cashier shifts.
  • -finalize, -complete — finish a stock count or a return.
  • -send, -receive, -cancel — send, receive, or cancel a stock transfer.
  • -process — accept or reject dine-in orders.
  • -approve — approve discounts; -confirm-payment — confirm bank transfer payments.
  • pos-access — use the cashier screen.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.desc: No permission has that name. Try a shorter word, for example stock, or clear the search box and press Enter.

pagination.title: Pages
pagination.desc: Permissions are spread over several pages. Use the page numbers or arrows to move between them.

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Open Access Groups to bundle permissions into a group (for example Morning Cashier), then Users to give that group to an employee.

intro.title: Cashier Screen
intro.desc:
This is where you record sales. The order is always the same:
  1. Pick the items being bought.
  2. Check the quantities in the cart.
  3. Choose how the customer pays and enter the money received.
  4. Press Selesaikan Transaksi (Complete Transaction), then print or send the receipt.
This guide shows where each part is.

menu.title: Menu ☰
menu.desc: On a phone, this button opens the menu: Dashboard, Riwayat Transaksi (transaction history), Profil (profile), Guided Tour, Layar penuh (full screen), and Keluar (log out).

search.title: Find an item
search.desc: Type part of an item's name, for example coffee — the list below filters straight away. Have a barcode scanner? Scan the item's barcode and it goes straight into the cart. On a computer, press / to start typing in this box.

categories.title: Categories
categories.desc: Tap a category name to show only the items in that group. Semua (all) shows every item again.

grid.title: Item list
grid.desc:
Tap an item to put it in the cart — each tap adds 1. Marks on items:
  • Habis (sold out) — stock is 0, it cannot be sold.
  • Sisa 3 (3 left) — stock is running low.
  • A red label — the item is on promotion.
Items sold in several units (pcs, box) show small unit buttons under the price: choose the unit first, then tap the item.

tab_cart.title: Open the cart
tab_cart.desc: On a phone, the item list and the cart are on two tabs. The number on the Keranjang (cart) tab shows how many items you picked. Press Next — the guide opens the Cart tab for you.

customer.title: Customer (optional)
customer.desc: For a walk-in customer who pays now, leave it empty — the receipt says Umum (general). Pick a customer to record who is buying, give member points, or record a debt (Bayar Belakangan, pay later). New customers can be registered on the spot with Tambah pelanggan (add customer).

held.title: Transaksi Ditahan (held transactions)
held.desc: Sales that were put on hold wait here. Tap one to continue it.

hold.title: Tahan (Hold)
hold.desc: The customer is still choosing while another is waiting? Press Tahan (hold): the cart is saved and emptied for the next customer. Continue it later from the Transaksi Ditahan (held transactions) list.

cart.title: Keranjang (Cart)
cart.desc: The chosen items appear here with their prices. Press + or − to change the quantity, and the bin icon to remove an item the customer no longer wants.

paylater.title: Bayar Belakangan (Pay Later)
paylater.desc: Turn this on when the customer owes the money (pays later). A customer and a due date are required. The debt is recorded under Receivables, where you record the payment when the customer pays.

order.title: Detail Pesanan (Order Details)
order.desc:
• Tipe Pesanan (order type): Di Tempat (dine in), Bawa Pulang (take away), or Diantar (delivery — a shipping cost field appears).
  • Diskon Manual (manual discount): a price cut in rupiah, for example 2000. If the owner set a discount limit, a bigger discount waits for approval under Discount Approval.
  • Catatan (notes): a special request, for example no sugar.
You can leave all of them as they are.

method.title: Metode Pembayaran (Payment Method)
method.desc: Choose how the customer pays: Tunai (cash), or Transfer Bank and online payment once they are enabled in Settings → Payment Gateway. Split Pembayaran (split payment) is for paying two ways, for example part cash and part transfer.

cash.title: Money received
cash.desc: Type the amount the customer hands over, or tap a quick amount button (Rp 10,000, Rp 50,000, …). Uang pas (exact amount) fills in the bill exactly. Kembalian (change) works out the money to give back.

summary.title: Total
summary.desc: The bill breakdown: item prices, promotions, discounts, shipping, and VAT (PPN) when the items are taxed. Total is what the customer has to pay.

submit.title: Selesaikan Transaksi (Complete Transaction)
submit.desc: Press this once the money is received. When the button is grey, its text tells you what is missing — for example Kurang Rp 2.000 (short by Rp 2,000) or Pilih Pelanggan (choose a customer). After it succeeds, the receipt page opens for printing or sending.

nav.title: Dashboard and History
nav.desc: Dashboard goes back to the store summary. Riwayat (history) lists recorded sales — from there you can reprint an old receipt or take back returned items.

shift.title: Active shift
shift.desc: This number is the money that should be in the drawer now: the opening cash plus cash sales. Press it to see the shift details and close the shift when you finish.

help.title: Guide
help.desc: This ? button opens the guide for the page you are on. Every page has its own guide.

intro.title: Open a shift first
intro.desc: Before selling, the cashier must open a shift. A shift is the cashier's working period — opened when starting, closed when finishing. While the shift runs, the app records every sale and the money going into the drawer, so the drawer can be checked against the records at the end of the day.

cash.title: Modal Awal (Opening Cash)
cash.desc: Enter the cash in the drawer before you start selling — usually small change. Type the number only, without dots, for example 100000 for Rp 100,000. If the drawer is empty, enter 0.

notes.title: Catatan (Notes, optional)
notes.desc: Extra information if needed, for example morning shift or the name of a stand-in cashier.

warehouse.title: Gudang (Warehouse)
warehouse.desc: Appears when the store has more than one warehouse. Choose the warehouse the sold items are taken from — the stock of sold items is reduced in this warehouse.

open.title: Buka Shift Sekarang (Open Shift Now)
open.desc: Press this after entering the opening cash. The cashier screen opens right away, and the next guide explains how to sell.

history.title: Lihat Histori Shift (View Shift History)
history.desc: Opens the list of earlier shifts: when they were opened and closed, who the cashier was, and any cash difference when they were closed.

intro.title: Promo Harga (Price Promos)
intro.desc: Here you create promos that are calculated automatically on the cashier screen — the cashier types no discount. Examples: all drinks 10% off, Chitato cheaper when buying 3, an Indomie + coffee bundle for Rp 20,000, or buy 2 get 1 free. Each promo is called a rule. Start with Buat Rule (create rule).

add.title: Buat Rule (create rule)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new promo. There are four kinds: Diskon Standar (standard discount), Harga Grosir (wholesale: cheaper when buying more), Bundle Price (package price), and Buy X Get Y (buy some, get one free). The form explains each. A new promo applies at the outlet currently selected at the top of the screen.

summary.title: Promos per status
summary.desc:
• Aktif (active) — running now.
  • Terjadwal (scheduled) — set up, but its start date has not arrived.
  • Expired — its end date has passed.
  • Inactive — switched off (Aktifkan rule ini unticked).

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a promo name to search — the list filters as you type. You can also filter by status (Aktif/Nonaktif — active/inactive), target (all products, one product, or a category), and promo kind.

list.title: Daftar Rule Pricing (promo list)
list.desc:
• Rule — promo name and start time.
  • Target — the products covered: one product, one category, or Semua Produk (all products).
  • Scope — who qualifies: Semua (everyone), Umum (no customer chosen), Pelanggan (registered), or Member.
  • Jenis (kind) — Standar, Grosir (wholesale), Bundle, or BXGY (Buy X Get Y).
  • Diskon — the discount or promo price. For Grosir, see the details in the edit form.
  • Priority — the order number; the higher, the earlier it wins.
  • Status — active, scheduled, expired, or inactive (switched off).

row.title: Edit or delete a promo
row.desc: At the right end of the row: the yellow pencil edits the promo, the red bin deletes it. Deleting cannot be undone. Want to pause a promo instead? Edit it and untick Aktifkan rule ini (activate this rule) — you can switch it back on any time. On a phone, swipe the table left to see the buttons.

empty.title: No promos yet
empty.desc: No promo matches. Clear the search and filters, or press Buat Rule (create rule) for your first promo.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: When there is a lot of data, the list is split into pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

activity.title: Aktivitas Promo Terbaru (recent activity)
activity.desc: The last five records: which promo was created, changed, or deleted, and when. The small line below is the event code, for example pricing_rule.updated (changed). The full record is in the Audit Logs menu.

intro.title: Filling in a price promo
intro.desc: This form creates or edits one promo. In order: give it a name, choose the promo kind, decide which products and customers qualify, enter the discount, then set the schedule. The middle of the form changes with the kind you choose. Before saving, try it with Jalankan Preview (run preview).

name.title: Nama Rule (name, required)
name.desc: An easy-to-recognise promo name, for example Drinks 10% Off or Buy 2 Get 1 Indomie. It is shown in the cart on the cashier screen, under each item the promo applies to.

kind.title: Jenis Rule (promo kind)
kind.desc:
• Diskon Standar (standard discount) — a plain discount. Example: all drinks 10% off.
  • Harga Grosir / Qty Break (wholesale) — the more you buy, the cheaper. Example: Chitato Rp 10,000; buy 3 or more and each is Rp 9,000.
  • Bundle Price — one price for several items together. Example: Indomie + Iced Coffee = Rp 20,000.
  • Buy X Get Y — buy certain items, get another free. Example: buy 2 Indomie, get 1 free.

priority.title: Priority (order)
priority.desc: Decides which promo wins when one item has several. The till applies only one discount or wholesale promo per item: the one with the highest number wins (if equal, the bigger discount). Bundle and Buy X Get Y promos are worked out first. If unsure, leave 100.

preview_qty.title: Qty Preview POS
preview_qty.desc: The sample quantity used to work out the promo price that is shown — by the Jalankan Preview (run preview) button below, and for wholesale promos also on the promo label of the product card on the cashier screen. It does not change the discount in real sales. Leave it at 1; for wholesale, enter the minimum wholesale quantity, for example 3.

target.title: Target Rule
target.desc:
Which products the promo covers:
  • Semua Produk (all products) — everything in the store.
  • Produk Tertentu (one product) — choose it in the Produk box that appears.
  • Kategori Tertentu (one category) — every product in one category, for example Drinks; choose it in the Kategori box.
For Bundle and Buy X Get Y the products are chosen in their own section below; pick Produk Tertentu = one of those products so the promo label on the cashier screen doesn't appear on every product.

scope.title: Scope Pelanggan (who qualifies)
scope.desc:
Who gets the promo:
  • Semua Pelanggan — anyone.
  • Tanpa Pelanggan / Umum (walk-in) — only when the cashier does not choose a customer.
  • Pelanggan Terdaftar (registered) — only when the cashier chooses a registered customer.
  • Member Loyalty — active members only; then tick the tiers that qualify.

product.title: Produk (product)
product.desc: Appears when Target Rule = Produk Tertentu. Choose the one product the promo covers, for example Aqua 600ml bottle. Required.

category.title: Kategori (category)
category.desc: Appears when Target Rule = Kategori Tertentu. Choose the category, for example Drinks — every product in it gets the promo. Required.

tiers.title: Tier Member yang Berhak (eligible tiers)
tiers.desc: Appears when Scope = Member Loyalty. Tick the levels that get the promo, for example only Gold and Platinum. Nothing ticked = every active member qualifies.

discount.title: Diskon Rule (discount)
discount.desc:
Tipe Diskon (discount type):
  • Persentase (%) — a percentage off. Type 10 for 10%.
  • Potongan Nominal (amount off) — rupiah off each item. Type 2000: Rp 10,000 becomes Rp 8,000.
  • Harga Final (final price) — the new price per item. Type 9000: it sells for Rp 9,000.
Nilai Diskon (discount value) is required. For wholesale promos this value is only the promo label; the real discount is set per quantity below.

qty_breaks.title: Qty Break / Grosir (wholesale levels)
qty_breaks.desc: One row = one price level. Fill in Min qty (minimum quantity), the type, and the Nilai (value). Chitato example: row 1 — min 3, Harga Final 9000; row 2 — min 6, Harga Final 8500. Buy 4 → all at Rp 9,000; buy 6 → Rp 8,500 each. Press Tambah Break (add level) for a new row, or the bin icon to remove one.

bundle.title: Bundle Price (package price)
bundle.desc: Enter the Harga Bundle (bundle price) — the price of one package, for example 20000. Then choose the items in the package and their quantities — at least 2 items; press Tambah Item Bundle (add bundle item) for more. At the till, as soon as all the items are in the cart, the bundle price applies automatically. Two packages → the bundle price counts twice.

buy_get.title: Buy X Get Y
buy_get.desc: Each row has a role, a product, and a quantity. Buy = what must be bought; Get = what becomes free. Buy-2-get-1 example: Buy row — Indomie, 2; Get row — Indomie, 1. The cashier still puts 3 Indomie in the cart; one automatically becomes Rp 0. You need at least one Buy row and one Get row.

schedule.title: Jadwal & Catatan (schedule & notes, optional)
schedule.desc: Fill in Mulai (start) and Berakhir (end) if the promo runs only for a period, for example an Independence Day promo. Left empty = runs from the moment it is saved, with no end. Catatan (notes) are for yourself, for example supplier-funded promo.

active.title: Aktifkan rule ini (activate)
active.desc: Tick it so the promo runs. Untick it to switch the promo off for a while without deleting it — for example while the promo item is out of stock. A switched-off promo shows as inactive in the list.

preview.title: Preview Draft (try it first)
preview.desc: Press Jalankan Preview (run preview) to try the promo on sample products before saving — nothing is saved. You see Base subtotal (normal price), Promo discount (total discount), After promo (price after the promo), and Applied Groups (bundles formed). If nothing appears, check the required fields.

submit.title: Simpan Rule (save rule)
submit.desc: Press Simpan Rule. When it works, you return to the promo list and the promo applies on the cashier screen according to its schedule. Red text under a field means something is missing. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

intro.title: Products Page
intro.desc: The list of everything your store sells, with prices and stock. Items here appear on the cashier screen. From here you add new items, change prices, or print barcode labels.

actions.title: Top-right buttons
actions.desc:
• Tambah Produk (add product) — register a new item.
  • Cetak All Barcode (print all barcodes) — print barcode labels for every item on this page.
  • Export — download the item list as an Excel file.
  • Import — add many items at once from an Excel file.

search.title: Search and select
search.desc: Type a name, SKU, or barcode and press Enter to search. Tick Pilih Semua (select all) or the small box on each item to pick several items at once, for example to print only their barcodes.

view.title: View
view.desc: Switch between picture tiles and a table. The table view shows purchase price, selling price, and stock on one line, with the edit and delete buttons always visible. When items are ticked, a Cetak Terpilih (print selected) button appears here.

list.title: Item list
list.desc: Each item shows its category, name, barcode/SKU, selling price (purple), cost (purchase price), and profit per item (green). Stock labels: Habis (sold out) in red, low stock in yellow.

row.title: Edit or delete an item
row.desc: In tile view, point at or tap the item's picture to show the pencil (edit) and bin (delete) buttons. In table view, the buttons are at the right end of the row. Deleting cannot be undone — for items that have already been sold, edit them instead of deleting.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: This store has no items yet. Press Tambah Produk (add product) to register the first one — it can then be sold on the cashier screen straight away.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many items are split over several pages. Use the page numbers here to move between them, and choose how many items show per page.

intro.title: Filling in an item
intro.desc: This form registers or edits one item. Required: category, barcode, SKU, name, purchase price, and selling price. You may skip the other fields. This guide explains each part with examples.

image.title: Item picture (optional)
image.desc: A photo helps the cashier find the item faster on the cashier screen. Press the file button and pick a photo from your gallery or camera. Items without a photo can still be sold.

category.title: Kategori (Category)
category.desc: Choose the group, for example Drinks. No category yet? Create one in the Categories menu first, then come back.

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.desc: The number under the black lines on the packaging. Fill it in with a scanner or type it. Home-made items without a barcode? Use any easy code, for example KOPI001 — you can print its label from the Products page.

sku.title: SKU
sku.desc: Your store's own item code, to tell similar items apart — for example KOPI-SUSU-250. It must differ from every other item's SKU. It may equal the barcode if you have no coding system of your own.

name.title: Nama Produk (Product Name)
name.desc: The name shown on the cashier screen and on receipts, for example Palm Sugar Iced Coffee. Use a name the cashier can easily search for.

description.title: Deskripsi (Description, optional)
description.desc: Extra notes for yourself, such as size or flavour. Not printed on receipts.

composite.title: Produk Komposit (Composite Product)
composite.desc: Tick this when the item is a bundle of other items — for example Value Pack = 1 rice + 1 tea. The bundle's price and stock are then worked out from its parts. Leave it unticked for ordinary items.

prices.title: Purchase price, selling price, stock
prices.desc:
• Harga Beli (purchase price) — your cost per item (the supplier's price), for example 4000. Used to work out profit.
  • Harga Jual (selling price) — the price for customers, for example 8000.
  • Stok (stock) — how many you have now (only when adding a new item).
Type numbers only, without dots or "Rp".

stock_now.title: Stok Saat Ini (current stock)
stock_now.desc: When editing an item, stock is not typed in directly. It changes through sales, Goods Receiving from suppliers, or Stock Opname (a stock recount) — so every stock change keeps a record of where it came from.

minmax.title: Minimum and maximum stock (optional)
minmax.desc: Stok Minimum (minimum stock): your safety level, for example 5. When stock reaches it, the system prepares a draft Purchase Order to the supplier automatically each day. Stok Maksimum (maximum stock): the most you want to keep — used to work out how much to order.

tax.title: Tax (VAT)
tax.desc:
• Exclusive — tax is added on top of the selling price. A price of 8000 with 11% tax becomes 8880 at the till.
  • Inclusive — the selling price already includes tax; the customer still pays 8000.
Stores that do not charge VAT: set Persentase Pajak (tax percentage) to 0.

profit.title: Estimated profit
profit.desc: Appears once both prices are filled in: the profit per item and its percentage (margin). Check it here before saving to avoid pricing mistakes.

units.title: Satuan (Units, optional)
units.desc: For items sold in several units, for example per pcs and per box of 12. Press + Tambah Satuan (add unit), choose the unit, fill in the Konversi (conversion: 1 box = 12), that unit's price, and its barcode if any. Items sold one way only need nothing here.

components.title: Komponen Paket (bundle parts)
components.desc: Appears when Produk Komposit is ticked. Press + Tambah Komponen (add component), choose each part and its quantity. When the bundle sells, each part's stock goes down too.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan Produk (save product). If a field is wrong or missing, a red message appears under it — fix it and save again. Batal (cancel) goes back to the product list without saving.

intro.title: Profil (Profile)
intro.desc: Settings for your own account: name, email, photo, and password. Everyone who uses the app — owner or cashier — has their own account, and changes here only affect the account that is signed in. You reach this page from the account menu (the circle at the top right) → Profile.

name.title: Nama (Name)
name.desc: Your name, for example Siti. It is printed on receipts as Kasir (cashier) for the sales you serve, and shown in the account menu. Use a name buyers will recognise, not an email address.

email.title: Surel (Email)
email.desc: The email address you sign in with. If you change it, you sign in with the new one next time. Each email can be used by only one account.

photo.title: Foto (Photo, optional)
photo.desc: A face photo or small picture for your account, shown in the account-menu circle at the top right. Press the file button and pick an image from your gallery or camera (at most 2 MB). Without a photo, the circle shows the first letter of your name.

save.title: Save profile
save.desc: Press Simpan (save) to store the name, email, and photo together. Tersimpan. (saved) appears briefly on success; wrong fields are marked with red text.

password.title: Change password
password.desc:
• Kata sandi sekarang (current password) — the password you sign in with now.
  • Kata sandi baru (new password) — at least 8 characters; longer is safer.
  • Ulangi kata sandi baru (repeat new password) — type it again, exactly the same.
Then press Simpan (save) in this box. Next time you sign in with the new password. If you sign in with the Masuk dengan akun Aishii (sign in with Aishii account) button, this password is not used for signing in — change your password in your Aishii account instead.

delete.title: Delete account — careful!
delete.desc:
Deletes your account for good and cannot be undone: you are signed out at once and can never sign in with this account again.
  • Store owner: do not delete your account. This page does not stop you, and the store could lose its only manager.
  • Staff who leave need not delete their account — the owner simply changes their password or Akses Group (role) in the Users menu.
  • An account that has already recorded sales cannot be deleted.
If you still want to, press Hapus akun (delete account) and type your password to confirm.

intro.title: Purchase Orders
intro.desc: The list of Purchase Orders (POs) — your written orders to a supplier (a wholesaler or distributor). Use it when stock runs low and you want to reorder, for example 10 cases of bottled water from your usual supplier. The flow: create a PO → order from the supplier → record the delivery in Goods Receiving. Start by pressing Buat PO (create PO).

add.title: Buat PO (create PO)
add.desc: Opens a new PO form: choose the supplier, the destination warehouse, then the items and quantities. A new PO is always saved as a Draft — stock does not change and nothing is sent to the supplier. This button appears if you are allowed to create POs.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a PO number (for example PO-20261015-0001) to search. Pick a status under Semua Status (all statuses) or a supplier under Semua Supplier (all suppliers) to show only some POs — for example only those still Dipesan (ordered). The list updates straight away.

list.title: PO list
list.desc:
Each row is one PO: Dokumen (PO number and date created), Supplier, Status, Item (number of different items), and Dibuat Oleh (created by). Statuses:
  • Draft — not ordered yet.
  • Dipesan (ordered) — waiting for the goods to arrive.
  • Sebagian Diterima (partly received) — only part of the goods has arrived.
  • Selesai (completed) — everything has arrived.
  • Dibatalkan (cancelled) — not going ahead.

row.title: Open a PO
row.desc: Press the eye button at the right end of the row to open the PO. That is where you order, cancel, or receive its goods. On a phone, swipe the table to the left first to see the other columns and the eye button.

empty.title: No POs yet
empty.desc: There are no POs yet, or none match your search and filters. Clear the search box and choose Semua Status (all statuses) to see everything, or press Buat PO (create PO) to make your first order.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many POs are split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and choose how many POs show per page.

next.title: Next steps
next.desc:
1. Open a Draft PO, check it, then press Pesan ke Supplier (order from supplier) once you have ordered by phone or WhatsApp.
  2. When the goods arrive, record them in Goods Receiving — stock goes up and, if the PO has a supplier, the debt is recorded.
  3. Pay that debt in Supplier Payables.
Items with a Stok Minimum (minimum stock) and Stok Maksimum (maximum stock) get a draft PO automatically every day when their warehouse stock falls to the minimum (note Auto-generated from restock suggestion). These drafts have no supplier and are made again the next day while stock stays low — cancel the ones you do not use.

intro.title: Create a Purchase Order
intro.desc: This form creates a purchase order (PO) to a supplier. Required: at least one item. Also choose the supplier and the destination warehouse so stock and debt are recorded correctly. The PO is saved as a Draft — stock does not change and nothing is sent to the supplier. Example: ordering 10 cases of water and 5 sacks of rice from a wholesaler.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.desc: Choose the supplier you are ordering from, for example CV Makmur Jaya. You may leave it empty, but without a supplier no debt is recorded when the goods arrive. Supplier not in the list? Add it in the Suppliers menu first, then open this form again.

warehouse.title: Tujuan Gudang (destination warehouse)
warehouse.desc: The warehouse where the goods will be kept — when they arrive, its stock goes up. The cashier only sells stock from the warehouse of the outlet (store) where the cashier shift is open, so choose your selling store's warehouse if the goods go straight on sale. Stock in the central warehouse can only be sold after moving it with Stock Transfers. Don't leave it empty: a PO without a warehouse may fail to open or to be received.

number.title: Nomor Dokumen (document number, optional)
number.desc: Leave it empty — a number is made automatically, for example PO-20261015-0001 (PO-date-sequence). Only type your own if you have an order number, for example from the supplier's note. It must not match another PO's number.

notes.title: Catatan (note, optional)
notes.desc: A note for yourself, for example Deliver before Saturday, pay within 2 weeks. It shows on the PO's detail page.

search.title: Find items
search.desc: Type an item name or SKU (your store's own item code), then press the item that appears to add it to the PO. Under each name you see the SKU, current stock, and purchase price. Each item can be added only once — change its quantity in the table.

items.title: Item Pembelian (items to buy)
items.desc:
• Qty — how many you order, at least 1. Example: type 10.
  • Harga (price) — purchase price per unit, filled in from the item's purchase price. Change it if the supplier quotes a different price; the price saved on the item itself does not change.
  • Subtotal — Qty × Harga.
  • Bin button — removes the item from the PO.
The Total below is the estimated cost of the whole PO.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: The PO has no items yet. Search in the box above, then press an item's name. A PO cannot be saved without items.

submit.title: Save the PO
submit.desc: Press Simpan PO (save PO). The PO is saved as a Draft and its detail page opens — from there you press Pesan ke Supplier (order from supplier). A PO cannot be edited once saved, so check the items, quantities, and prices first. Batal (cancel) returns to the list without saving.

intro.title: Purchase Order details
intro.desc: The page for one PO: what was ordered, its status, the goods already received, and the debt. From here you order from the supplier, cancel the PO, or record goods that arrived. The buttons shown depend on the PO's status and your permissions.

header.title: Number and status
header.desc:
The PO number and status, then the supplier, who created it, and when. A Dipesan (ordered) line appears once the PO has been ordered.
  • Draft — not ordered yet; can be ordered or cancelled.
  • Dipesan (ordered) — waiting for the goods to arrive.
  • Sebagian Diterima (partly received) — the rest is still expected.
  • Selesai (completed) — everything has arrived.
  • Dibatalkan (cancelled) — not going ahead.

place.title: Pesan ke Supplier (order from supplier)
place.desc: Press this after you have actually ordered from the supplier (by phone, WhatsApp, or in person) — the app does not send anything to the supplier. The status becomes Dipesan (ordered) and the order date is recorded. It happens immediately without a confirmation question, and the PO cannot go back to Draft. Shown only for Draft POs.

cancel.title: Batalkan PO (cancel PO)
cancel.desc: Cancels a PO that is not completed — for example when the supplier is out of stock or the price changed. It happens immediately without a confirmation question and cannot be undone; you return to the PO list. Goods already received stay in stock, and any debt already recorded stays. PO contents wrong? Cancel it, then create a new PO.

receive.title: Terima Barang (receive goods)
receive.desc: Press this when the supplier's delivery arrives. The Terima Barang form opens — pick this PO in the selection box, then fill in how many arrived. You can use it several times if the goods come in batches. Shown for POs that are Dipesan (ordered) or Sebagian Diterima (partly received).

items.title: Item Purchase Order (PO items)
items.desc:
• Qty Dipesan (qty ordered) — how many were ordered.
  • Qty Diterima (qty received) — how many have arrived.
  • Sisa (remaining) — not arrived yet: yellow while still expected, a green 0 when complete.
  • Harga Satuan (unit price) and Subtotal — purchase price per item, and Qty Dipesan × price.
On a phone, swipe the table left to see every column.

receivings.title: Riwayat Penerimaan Barang (receiving history)
receivings.desc: Each time goods for this PO were received, a row appears here: the receiving number (GR-…, short for Goods Receiving), the date received, and the number of different items. Press Detail to see what arrived.

payable.title: Hutang Supplier (supplier debt)
payable.desc: The debt to the supplier, recorded automatically when this PO's goods were received: the bill Total and the amount Dibayar (paid). Press Lihat Detail Hutang (view debt details) to record a payment. Shown only when the PO has a supplier and goods have been received.

flow.title: Alur PO (PO workflow)
flow.desc: A summary of the PO workflow. Ordered here means the Dipesan status. A debt is recorded automatically only when the PO has a supplier, due 30 days after the goods are received.

intro.title: Nota Barang (Piutang) — Receivables
intro.desc:
A receivable is money a customer still owes the store — it happens when a customer buys with Bayar Belakangan (pay later, on credit). Each debt is recorded as one nota barang (credit note). Here you see who has not paid, how much is left, and the due date (the deadline to pay).

Example: Mrs Ani takes Rp 150,000 of rice and promises to pay at the end of the month.

tabs.title: Daftar and Aging
tabs.desc: Daftar (list) shows every receivable. Aging shows a summary: total receivables, the amount paid, the Collection Rate (the share already collected), debts grouped by how long they are past the due date, and the customers who owe the most.

create.title: Buat Dari POS (create from the cashier)
create.desc: New receivables are created on the cashier screen, not here. Press this button, choose the items and the customer, switch on Bayar Belakangan (Nota Barang) (pay later), fill in the due date, and finish the sale. The note appears in this list right away.

filters.title: Find a note
filters.desc: Type an invoice or note number, or choose a status (Belum Lunas unpaid, Parsial partly paid, Lunas paid, Jatuh Tempo overdue), then press Terapkan (apply).

list.title: Receivables list
list.desc:
• Invoice — the note number; POS # under it means it came from a sale at the cashier.
  • Pelanggan (customer) — who owes the money.
  • Total — the amount owed.
  • Sisa (remaining) — what has not been paid.
  • Jatuh Tempo (due date) — the deadline to pay.
On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see every column.

row.title: Status and payments
row.desc:
Note status:
  • Belum Lunas (unpaid) — nothing paid yet.
  • Parsial (partial) — partly paid in instalments.
  • Lunas (paid) — fully paid.
  • Jatuh Tempo (overdue, red) — past the due date and not fully paid. Collect it soon.
Press the row to open the note and record a payment (instalment) from the customer.

empty.title: No receivables yet
empty.desc: No matching receivables. If you searched, clear the search and press Terapkan (apply). Receivables appear here after a Bayar Belakangan (pay later) sale at the cashier.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Menampilkan … dari … data (showing … of … records) = how many notes are on this page out of all of them. Use the page numbers and the previous/next buttons to move between pages.

aging_cards.title: Receivables summary
aging_cards.desc:
• Total Piutang (total receivables) — the sum of all receivable notes.
  • Sudah Dibayar (already paid) — what customers have paid.
  • Collection Rate — the share already collected; 100% means everything is paid.
  • Lunas / Total (paid / total) — the number of paid notes out of all notes.

aging_buckets.title: Aging Piutang (receivables aging)
aging_buckets.desc:
Aging groups unpaid debts by how many days they are past the due date:
  • Belum Jatuh Tempo (not yet due) — still within the deadline.
  • 1-30 Hari (days) — up to a month late.
  • 31-60 Hari, 61-90 Hari, 90+ Hari — the longer it is, the harder it is to collect; chase these first.
On the right: the remaining debt and the number of notes in that group.

aging_top.title: Pelanggan Terbesar (largest debtors)
aging_top.desc: The customers with the largest remaining debt. The orange amount = what is still unpaid; Total = their outstanding debt. Contact them first.

intro.title: Receivable details
intro.desc:
One customer debt, with its note number in the title. Here you record every payment (instalment) received, send a reminder through WhatsApp, and print the note.

Example: Mrs Ani pays Rp 50,000 of a Rp 150,000 debt — record it with Tambah Pembayaran (add payment), and the remainder becomes Rp 100,000 automatically.

actions.title: Reminders and status
actions.desc:
• Share WhatsApp — opens WhatsApp with the note number, total, and remaining debt; pick the customer's contact and send.
  • Campaign WA (if shown) — prepares a payment reminder in the CRM Campaigns menu.
  • Status label: Belum Lunas (unpaid), Parsial (partly paid), Lunas (paid), or Jatuh Tempo (overdue).

customer.title: Customer and due date
customer.desc: The name of the customer who owes the money, and Jatuh Tempo (due date) — the last day they promised to pay.

amounts.title: Total, paid, remaining
amounts.desc:
• Total — the amount owed.
  • Terbayar (paid) — all payments recorded so far.
  • Sisa (remaining) — what the customer still has to pay.
Returning goods from this sale also lowers the Total.

add.title: Tambah Pembayaran (add payment)
add.desc:
Press it when the customer pays. The form appears in the right-hand column (on a phone: further down):
  • Nominal (amount) — the money received; type for example 50000. It cannot exceed the remainder.
  • Tanggal Bayar (payment date) — already set to today.
  • Tunai (cash) or Transfer — for a transfer, choose the receiving Rekening (account).
  • Catatan (note) — optional.
Then press Simpan Pembayaran (save payment). A saved payment cannot be deleted from this screen.

history.title: Riwayat Pembayaran (payment history)
history.desc: Every recorded payment: amount, date, method (cash, bank_transfer) with the bank, the note, and on the right the person who recorded it. Belum ada pembayaran. (no payments yet) means the customer has not paid anything.

detail.title: Detail Nota (note details)
detail.desc: Invoice number, due date, and status. Lihat (view) on the ID Transaksi (transaction) line opens the original sale's receipt, to see which items were bought (shown when the note came from the cashier).

notes.title: Catatan Penagihan (collection notes)
notes.desc: Notes for yourself about collecting the debt, for example called on 12 Oct, promised to pay Friday. Press Simpan Catatan (save note). These notes are not sent to the customer and are not printed on the note.

payform.title: Payment form
payform.desc:
Fill in Nominal (amount), check Tanggal Bayar (payment date), choose Tunai (cash) or Transfer, then press Simpan Pembayaran (save payment). Once fully paid, the note and its original sale become Lunas (paid).

This payment is not counted in the drawer cash of Cashier Shifts; if the cash goes into the cashier's drawer, also record it as Kas Masuk (cash in).

print.title: Preview / PDF
print.desc: Shows a preview of the receivable note: customer, total, paid, remaining, and payment history. Inside it, PDF / Cetak (PDF / print) opens a PDF to print or send to the customer, and Tutup (close) closes the preview.

intro.title: Laporan Penjualan (sales report)
intro.desc:
A summary of every sale at the outlet selected in the top bar: money taken, profit, items sold, and discounts, plus the list of receipts. Use it at the end of the day, week, or month — for example to answer how much did we sell this week?

Without a filter the report counts all sales since the start. Begin by pressing Filter and choosing dates.

filter.title: Filter
filter.desc:
Press Filter to open the filter box:
  • Tanggal Mulai and Tanggal Akhir (start and end date) — a date range, for example the 1st to the 31st for one month.
  • Invoice — find one receipt by its number, for example TRX-…
  • Kasir (cashier) and Pelanggan (customer) — only one person's sales.
Press Terapkan (apply). A purple dot on the Filter button means a filter is active; the × button in the box clears all filters.

summary.title: Summary
summary.desc:
• Pendapatan Bersih (net revenue) — the money from all receipts after discounts, including VAT and delivery fees if any.
  • Total Profit — selling price minus cost. The Rata-rata (average) under it is the average spend per receipt, not the average profit.
  • Item Terjual (items sold) — items sold and the number of transactions.
  • Diskon Diberikan (discounts given) — manual discounts typed by the cashier; automatic promo discounts are not included.
Unpaid receipts are counted too.

table.title: Transaction list
table.desc:
One row per receipt, newest first:
  • Invoice — the receipt number.
  • Tanggal (date) — when it happened.
  • Pelanggan (customer) — - means a walk-in customer.
  • Kasir (cashier) — who served.
  • Item — number of items.
  • Total — what the customer paid.
  • Profit (green) — the profit on that receipt.
On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see every column.

empty.title: No data
empty.desc: No sales match the filter. Check the date range, or clear the filter with the × button in the Filter box. Haven't sold anything yet? Sales from the cashier screen appear here automatically.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: The report shows 10 receipts per page. Use the page numbers or arrows to see older receipts. The summary figures above still count every receipt, not just this page.

next.title: Other reports
next.desc:
• Profit Report — profit and margin per receipt.
  • Advanced Insights — busy hours, best and slowest sellers, cashier performance, and loyal customers.
Both are in the Reports menu.

intro.title: Advanced Sales Insights
intro.desc:
A full analysis of sales at the selected outlet: busy hours and days, best and slowest sellers, profit per item, cashier performance, loyal customers, how long stock will last, promotions, member points, and customer messages (CRM). Use it for a weekly or monthly review, for example to decide which items need more stock.

Start with Filter to choose a period.

filter.title: Filter
filter.desc:
Press Filter, choose Tanggal Mulai and Tanggal Akhir (start and end date), and if needed a Kasir (cashier), Pelanggan (customer), or item Kategori (category), then press Terapkan (apply). The × button clears the filter. Without dates, all data since the start is counted.

Promo counts, member numbers, points balance, and customer segments ignore the dates — they always show the current state.

summary.title: Key figures
summary.desc:
• Pendapatan (revenue) — total sales and the number of transactions.
  • Profit — selling price − cost. The Rata-rata (average) under it = average spend per transaction.
  • Item Terjual (items sold) — number of items; below it, the total manual discount given by cashiers.
  • Kasir Aktif di Filter (active cashiers) — how many cashiers sold something in this period.

charts.title: Sales charts
charts.desc:
• Sales by Hour — revenue (omzet) per hour of the day. The tallest bar = your busiest hour: have more cashiers and stock ready then. Hours without sales are not shown.
  • Sales by Day — revenue per day; a rising line means sales are growing.
Point at or tap a chart to see the figures.

customers.title: Customers and stock
customers.desc:
• Customer Aktif (active customers) — registered customers who bought in this period; pelanggan baru (new) = those who bought exactly once.
  • Repeat Rate — the share of customers who bought more than once.
  • Member Revenue Share — the share of sales that came from members (of the points programme).
  • Stok Perlu Perhatian (stock needing attention) — how many items are Critical or Low (see Stock Coverage Analysis below); the number of days below it = the length of the analysed period.

top.title: Top Selling Products
top.desc: The ten items that sold the most: Produk (product, with its SKU below), Kategori (category), Qty (quantity sold), Omzet (sales revenue), and Profit. Never let these items run out of stock.

low.title: Low Performing Products
low.desc: The ten items that are in stock but sold the least: Stok (stock), Qty Sold, Omzet (revenue), and Last Sold (- = not sold in this period). Consider a promotion, display them where customers can see them, or buy less of them.

margin.title: Margin per product / category
margin.desc: The most profitable items or categories: Qty, Omzet (revenue), Profit, and Margin % (profit divided by revenue × 100). Press Per Produk (per product) or Per Kategori (per category) to switch. A small margin means the selling price is too close to the cost.

cashiers.title: Cashier Performance
cashiers.desc: Each cashier's results: Transaksi (number of receipts), Items Sold, Omzet (revenue), Profit, and Avg Basket (average spend per receipt). Useful for comparing cashiers or working out bonuses.

repeat.title: Repeat Customer Metrics
repeat.desc:
• Repeat Revenue — sales from customers who bought more than once.
  • Revenue Member and Revenue Non-Member — sales from member and non-member customers.
The table lists customers who came back: Member or Non-member status with their tier (for example GOLD), the number of Transaksi (transactions), Omzet (revenue), Avg Basket (average spend), and Last Purchase.

coverage.title: Stock Coverage Analysis
coverage.desc:
How many days your stock will last if sales stay like this period. Avg / Hari (per day) = average sold per day; Coverage = stock divided by that average.
  • Kritis (critical) — runs out in 7 days or less: restock now.
  • Rendah (low) — runs out within 30 days.
  • Sehat (healthy) — lasts more than 30 days.
  • Tidak Bergerak (not moving) — not sold at all in this period.

promo.title: Promo Active Monitor
promo.desc: Running price promotions: the number of Promo Aktif (active) and Promo Terjadwal (scheduled, not started yet), their type — Discount, Grosir (cheaper when buying many), Bundle (bundle price), BXGY (buy X get Y free) — and their period. Audit Promo Terbaru (latest promo changes) shows the last five changes to promotions.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Performance Summary
loyalty.desc: The member points programme: Total Member, Saldo Poin (points members still hold), Poin Earned and Poin Redeemed (points earned and spent) in this period, members per tier (REGULAR, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM), and vouchers that are active, already used, and their total discount. The table below: the five members who spent the most.

crm.title: CRM Operational Snapshot
crm.desc: Promotional messages and reminders to customers (CRM): Segment Aktif (active customer groups), Campaign Draft/Ready (campaigns not sent yet), Queue Ready (messages ready to send), and Queue Sent (messages sent). The table shows the five latest campaigns: type, status, Target (number of messages), and when it was processed.

intro.title: Laporan Keuntungan (profit report)
intro.desc:
How much you earned on each sale. The formula: selling price − purchase price (cost) for every item, after promo and cashier discounts. Example: coffee sold for 8000 that costs 4000 → 4000 profit per cup.

This is gross profit: rent, wages, and electricity are not subtracted. The figures are only right when every product's Harga Beli (purchase price) is filled in correctly. Start with Filter to choose dates.

filter.title: Filter
filter.desc:
Press Filter to open the filter box:
  • Tanggal Mulai and Tanggal Akhir (start and end date) — a date range, for example the 1st to the 31st for one month.
  • Invoice — find one receipt by its number, for example TRX-…
  • Kasir (cashier) and Pelanggan (customer) — only one person's sales.
Press Terapkan (apply). A purple dot on the Filter button means a filter is active; the × button in the box clears all filters.

summary.title: Profit summary
summary.desc:
• Total Profit — the profit of all receipts in the filter.
  • Rata-rata Profit (average profit) — the average profit per receipt; the number of transactions is shown below it.
  • Margin Kotor (gross margin) — Total Profit divided by total sales × 100%. A 30% margin means every Rp 100,000 of sales earns Rp 30,000.
  • Transaksi Terbaik (best transaction) — the receipt with the biggest profit, and that profit.

table.title: Profit per receipt
table.desc:
One row (on a phone: one card) per receipt: the Invoice number, date, cashier, customer, the Item count, Penjualan (sales: what the customer paid), and Profit (green).

VAT is not profit. Sales include VAT (PPN) and delivery fees if any, but VAT added on top of the price is not counted as profit — that money must be paid to the tax office. So the margin looks slightly smaller when you charge VAT.

empty.title: No data
empty.desc: No sales match the filter. Check the date range, or clear the filter with the × button in the Filter box.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: The report shows 10 receipts per page. Use the page numbers or arrows to see older receipts. The summary figures above still count every receipt, not just this page.

intro.title: Akses Group (access groups)
intro.desc:
An access group is a named bundle of permissions — like a person's role in the shop. Built-in groups: cashier (cashier screen, shifts, customers), manager (almost every store menu), and super-admin (everything, for the owner). There are also small per-menu groups, for example products-access, that can be combined.

Every user gets one or more groups in the Users menu.

add.title: Tambah Group (add group)
add.desc:
Press Tambah Group (add group), fill in Nama group (group name, required, for example Morning Cashier), press the box under Pilih hak akses (choose permissions), then tap each permission the group may use — chosen ones get a filled circle. Press Simpan (save).

For safety the app may ask you to retype your password (or Konfirmasi dengan akun Aishii, confirm with your Aishii account). After that what you typed is gone: do it again and save again. You won't be asked again for 15 minutes.

search.title: Search groups
search.desc: Type part of a group name and press Enter, for example cashier.

card.title: Group box
card.desc: Each box is one group: its name, how many permissions it has, and some of them (the first eight; the rest show as +… lainnya, more). Permission names are explained on the Permissions page.

actions.title: Edit and Hapus (delete)
actions.desc:
• Edit — change the group's name or permissions. The change applies to every user who has this group.
  • Hapus (delete) — deletes the group after confirmation. This cannot be undone; users who only had this group cannot open any menu until they get another group.
The super-admin group cannot be changed or deleted. Both actions may also ask for your password first.

empty.title: No groups
empty.desc: No groups are shown — usually because the search word doesn't match. Clear the search box and press Enter. The Tambah Group (add group) button creates a new group.

pagination.title: Pages
pagination.desc: Groups are spread over several pages, newest first. Use the page numbers or arrows to see the other groups.

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Open the Users menu to give groups to employees: add a new user or edit an existing one, then tick the group.

intro.title: Retur Penjualan (Sales Returns)
intro.desc:
A return means a customer brings back goods they bought — for example damaged, expired, or the wrong size. This page keeps a record of every return. Example: a customer brings back 1 leaking bottle of soy sauce.

New returns are not created here: open Transaction History, find the sale, and press Retur (return). The owner's account sees every return; other accounts only see returns of their own sales.

filters.title: Find a return
filters.desc:
Narrow the list with:
  • Kode retur (return code) — starts with SR-.
  • Invoice transaksi (sale invoice) — the original sale's number.
  • Two date boxes — from and to the date the return was made.
  • Method — Refund Tunai (cash refund) or Saldo Toko (store credit).
Then press Filter. Empty all boxes and press Filter again to see everything.

list.title: Return list
list.desc:
• Kode (code) — the return number.
  • Invoice — the original sale.
  • Tanggal (date) the return was made, and Pelanggan (customer; Umum = no name).
  • Metode (method) — Refund Tunai: money paid back in cash; Saldo Toko: the value is recorded as the customer's store credit.
  • Nominal (amount) — the value of the returned goods.
On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see every column.

row.title: Status and Lihat
row.desc:
• Draft (yellow) — the return is only noted; stock and money have not changed yet, and it can still be edited.
  • Completed (green) — the return is finished: stock, refund, or store credit have been processed. It can no longer be changed.
Press Lihat (view) to open a return. Drafts are completed from there.

empty.title: No returns yet
empty.desc: No matching returns. To record the first one: open Transaction History, find the sale, and press Retur (return).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many returns are split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and Tampilkan (show) to choose 10, 25, or 50 returns per page.

intro.title: Buat Retur Penjualan (Create Sales Return)
intro.desc:
Records goods a customer brings back from one sale; its invoice number is shown under the title. There are two stages:
  1. Buat Draft (create draft) — fill in the items and quantities, then save. Stock and money do not change yet.
  2. Selesaikan Retur (complete return) on the next page — only then are stock, refund, or store credit processed.
Example: a customer brings back 1 of 2 bottles of soy sauce because it leaks.

summary.title: Original sale
summary.desc: Pelanggan (customer), Metode Bayar (payment method; CASH, PAY LATER = on credit), and Total Transaksi (sale total) of the original sale. Nominal Retur (return amount) = the value of the returned goods; it updates by itself as you fill in quantities.

items.title: Item Retur (returned items)
items.desc:
Every item of that sale:
  • Qty Beli (quantity bought).
  • Sudah Retur (already returned) — returned earlier.
  • Sisa (remaining) — how many can still be returned.
  • Subtotal — the money value of the returned goods.
The table is wide: swipe sideways to see every column.

row.title: Fill in the returned goods
row.desc:
For each item brought back:
  • Qty Retur (return quantity) — how many, at most the Sisa (remaining). Leave 0 for items not returned.
  • Alasan (reason) — required, for example leaking or wrong size.
  • Restock — tick it if the item can still be sold: its stock goes back up. Untick it for damaged goods that will be thrown away.

method.title: Metode Penyelesaian (settlement)
method.desc:
How the customer gets their money back:
  • Refund Tunai (cash refund) — money paid back from the cash drawer; it reduces the drawer's Expected Cash in your shift.
  • Saldo Toko / Credit (store credit) — the value is recorded as the customer's credit. Only possible when the sale has a customer name. This credit cannot be spent from the cashier screen yet.
For a pay-later sale, the return first reduces the remaining debt.

notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
notes.desc: Extra information for the store's records, for example replaced with a new item or customer brought the receipt.

preview.title: Preview Dampak (impact preview)
preview.desc:
What the return will do:
  • Stok kembali (stock back) — items going back into stock (those with Restock ticked).
  • Refund — cash paid back to the customer.
  • Saldo toko (store credit) — value recorded as the customer's credit.
  • Piutang saat ini / setelah retur (debt now / after the return) — shown for pay-later sales.
  • Nominal retur (return amount) — the total value of the returned goods.
The refund is 0 when the sale was not paid yet. Check the numbers before saving.

save.title: Buat Draft (create draft)
save.desc: Press it to save the return as a draft. Stock and money do not change yet. Once saved, the return page opens: check it again, then press Selesaikan Retur (complete return) there. If something is missing, a red message appears under the table.

intro.title: Sales return details
intro.desc: One return record, with its code (SR-…) in the title and the original sale's invoice below it. While its status is Draft, you can still edit it and then process it with Selesaikan Retur (complete return). Once Completed, this page is for viewing only.

status.title: Return status
status.desc:
• Draft — not processed yet: stock, money, and store credit have not changed.
  • Completed — finished on the date shown next to it. It cannot be changed or undone.

summary.title: Original sale
summary.desc: Pelanggan (customer), Metode Bayar (payment method; CASH, PAY LATER = on credit), and Total Transaksi (sale total) of the original sale. Nominal Retur (return amount) = the value of the returned goods; it updates by itself as you fill in quantities.

items.title: Item Retur (returned items)
items.desc: The items of the original sale with the quantities being returned. Sudah Retur (already returned) only counts completed returns, and Sisa (remaining) is what can still be returned. The table is wide: swipe sideways to see every column.

row.title: Fill in the returned goods
row.desc:
For each item brought back:
  • Qty Retur (return quantity) — how many, at most the Sisa (remaining). Leave 0 for items not returned.
  • Alasan (reason) — required, for example leaking or wrong size.
  • Restock — tick it if the item can still be sold: its stock goes back up. Untick it for damaged goods that will be thrown away.

method.title: Metode Penyelesaian (settlement)
method.desc:
How the customer gets their money back:
  • Refund Tunai (cash refund) — money paid back from the cash drawer; it reduces the drawer's Expected Cash in your shift.
  • Saldo Toko / Credit (store credit) — the value is recorded as the customer's credit. Only possible when the sale has a customer name. This credit cannot be spent from the cashier screen yet.
For a pay-later sale, the return first reduces the remaining debt.

notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
notes.desc: Extra information for the store's records, for example replaced with a new item or customer brought the receipt.

preview.title: Preview Dampak (impact preview)
preview.desc:
What the return will do:
  • Stok kembali (stock back) — items going back into stock (those with Restock ticked).
  • Refund — cash paid back to the customer.
  • Saldo toko (store credit) — value recorded as the customer's credit.
  • Piutang saat ini / setelah retur (debt now / after the return) — shown for pay-later sales.
  • Nominal retur (return amount) — the total value of the returned goods.
The refund is 0 when the sale was not paid yet. Check the numbers before saving.

save.title: Simpan Draft (save draft)
save.desc: Shown while the return is a draft. After changing quantities, reasons, or the method, press Simpan Draft first. Stock and money still do not change.

complete.title: Selesaikan Retur (complete return)
complete.desc:
Processes the return:
  • Items with Restock ticked go back into the stock of the sale's warehouse.
  • A Refund Tunai (cash refund) reduces the drawer cash in your shift — you must have a cashier shift open.
  • The customer's credit goes up, or their debt goes down.
  • The profit of that sale is reduced too.
This cannot be undone. The button is grey while no item is being returned or changes are not saved yet.

intro.title: Add / Edit Bank Account
intro.desc: The form for one transfer account. Required: Nama Bank (bank name), Nomor Rekening (account number), and Atas Nama (account holder); the logo is optional. The cashier sees these details when choosing the destination account and they are printed on the receipt, so make sure there are no typos.

bank.title: Nama Bank (bank name, required)
bank.desc: The bank name as customers know it, for example BCA, Mandiri, BRI, or BSI.

number.title: Nomor Rekening (account number, required)
number.desc: Type the account number exactly as in your bank book or banking app, for example 0123456789. Check it twice: one wrong digit sends the customer's money to someone else's account.

name.title: Atas Nama (account holder, required)
name.desc: The account holder's name exactly as registered at the bank, for example Budi Santoso or CV Kopi Senja. Customers usually check this name before transferring.

logo.title: Logo Bank (bank logo, optional)
logo.desc: A picture of the bank's logo (PNG, JPG, or SVG, 1 MB at most) so the cashier recognises the account faster. When editing, leave it empty to keep the current logo.

active.title: Aktif (active)
active.desc: Ticked = the account appears as a choice on the cashier screen. Untick it to hide the account for a while, for example when the account has a problem.

submit.title: Save or cancel
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save; when editing: Update). If asked to type your password again, type it and press Lanjutkan (continue); you come back to this form, so fill it in again and save. After saving, the account list opens. Batal (cancel) or Kembali (back, top right) closes the form without saving.

intro.title: Bank Accounts
intro.desc: The store's accounts for receiving Transfer Bank (bank transfer) payments. When a customer pays by transfer, the cashier picks one of these accounts as the destination, and its number is printed on the receipt. Example: BCA 0123456789, Budi Santoso. No account yet? Press Tambah Bank (add bank).

outlet.title: Accounts per outlet
outlet.desc: A new account is recorded for the outlet shown here and only appears at that outlet's cashier. Accounts that apply to all outlets are listed too. Choose the outlet before adding an account.

add.title: Tambah Bank (Add Bank)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new account: bank name, account number, and account holder. This button only appears for users allowed to change payment settings.

list.title: Daftar Rekening (account list)
list.desc: The number in the title is how many accounts there are. Accounts marked Nonaktif (inactive) look faded and do not appear on the cashier screen.

row.title: One account
row.desc: The bank name (in bold), then the account number • the account holder's name. The bank logo shows in the left box once uploaded. Check the number carefully — customers transfer money to it.

actions.title: On/off, edit, delete
actions.desc:
• Aktif/Nonaktif (active/inactive) — press to show or hide the account at the cashier without deleting it.
  • Pencil — edit the account.
  • Bin — delete the account after a confirmation; this cannot be undone. Accounts already used in a sale cannot be deleted — make them inactive instead.
The app may ask for your password first; afterwards press the button again.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.desc: This store has no bank account yet. Press Tambah Bank (add bank) to register the first one.

next.title: Next steps
next.desc:
1. Open Settings → Payment Gateway and make sure Transfer Bank is Aktif (on).
  2. On the cashier screen, choose Transfer Bank and then the destination account.
  3. Once the money arrives, mark the sale paid in Transaction History.

intro.title: Loyalty Settings
intro.desc: The rules of your loyalty programme: customers who are members collect points every time they shop, then can swap points for a discount. Members are also grouped into tiers (levels) by how much they have spent. These rules apply to all outlets. A customer becomes a member through the Member tick in the customer's details or the Members menu.

earn.title: Aktifkan earn points (turn on earning)
earn.desc: Earn = collect points. When ticked, members get points from every sale. Untick it to stop giving new points — the points members already have are kept.

redeem.title: Aktifkan redeem points (turn on redeeming)
redeem.desc: Redeem = swap points for a discount at the cashier. When unticked, points cannot be used, but they are kept.

rate.title: Spend per point
rate.desc: Nominal belanja untuk 1 poin (spend for 1 point): how many rupiah of shopping earn 1 point. Example: enter 10000 → a Rp 57,500 purchase earns 5 points (rounded down; shipping is not counted). Required, at least 1.

value.title: Value per point
value.desc: Nilai rupiah per 1 poin redeem (rupiah per redeemed point): the discount for each point swapped. Example: enter 100 → 50 points = Rp 5,000 off. With 10000 and 100 as in these examples, members get back about 1% of what they spend. A points discount can never be more than the bill.

tiers.title: Threshold Tier
tiers.desc: A tier is a member's level based on everything they have spent so far; a threshold is the minimum total spend for each level. Example: Regular 0, Silver 500000, Gold 1500000, Platinum 3000000 → a member who has spent Rp 1,600,000 in total is Gold. The numbers must go up from Regular to Platinum. After saving, every member's tier is worked out again — it can go up or down. Offers in Price Promos can be limited to certain tiers.

submit.title: Simpan Pengaturan (Save Settings)
submit.desc: Press to save. The message Pengaturan loyalty disimpan (loyalty settings saved) appears when it works; if the tier numbers are not in order, a red message appears under the tier box.

intro.title: Outlets
intro.desc: An outlet is a place that sells — a shop, branch, or kiosk — with its own cashier shifts. Every outlet has a warehouse: where the stock that outlet sells is kept and counted. Example: Outlet Malabar sells from Gudang Malabar. Use this page when you open a new branch or change a branch's details.

add.title: Tambah Outlet (Add Outlet)
add.desc: Opens the form under the list to create a new outlet together with its warehouse. The new warehouse starts with every item at stock 0 — fill it through Stock Transfers or Goods Receiving.

row.title: One outlet
row.desc:
• The outlet name and its code, for example MAL.
  • Aktif (active) — the outlet is in use.
  • Penjualan aktif (selling) or Gudang pusat (central warehouse) — whether it sells or not (explained shortly).
  • The warehouse icon — the name of this outlet's warehouse.

warehouse.title: The outlet's warehouse
warehouse.desc: The name of the warehouse where this outlet's stock is recorded. Belum ada gudang (no warehouse yet) means the outlet has no stock location yet.

actions.title: Edit or delete
actions.desc:
• Green tick — the outlet is active.
  • Pencil — edit the outlet; the form opens under the list.
  • Bin — delete the outlet after a confirmation. Only for an outlet that was never used (no sales, shifts, or stock movements); otherwise make it inactive.
The app may ask for your password first.

sales.title: Penjualan aktif (selling)
sales.desc: This outlet sells: cashiers can open a shift here, and items sold reduce the stock of this outlet's warehouse. If the store is on a subscription plan, every active selling outlet counts towards the plan; the central warehouse does not.

pusat.title: Gudang pusat (central warehouse)
pusat.desc: An outlet with this label does not sell — it only stores stock. Cashiers cannot open a shift here, and its stock does not show on the cashier screen. To sell it, move the items to a selling outlet's warehouse with Stock Transfers. The outlet with the code PUSAT cannot be deleted and cannot become a selling outlet.

empty.title: No outlets yet
empty.desc: Press Tambah Outlet (add outlet) to create the first one.

form_identity.title: Name, code, contact
form_identity.desc:
• Nama Outlet (outlet name, required) — for example Dago Branch.
  • Kode Outlet (outlet code, required) — a short unique code of letters or digits without spaces, for example DGO; shown in the outlet picker.
  • Telepon (phone) and Email — optional.

form_address.title: Alamat (address, optional)
form_address.desc: The outlet's address, for example Jl. Dago No. 5, Bandung. The address printed on receipts is set separately in Settings → Store Profile for each outlet.

form_active.title: Outlet aktif (outlet active)
form_active.desc: Untick to stop using this outlet; every cashier shift there must be closed first. Note: an inactive outlet no longer shows in this list or in the outlet picker.

form_sales.title: Outlet melayani penjualan (outlet sells)
form_sales.desc: Ticked = the outlet sells (cashiers can open a shift here). Untick it to make it storage only. It cannot be changed for PUSAT. If a plan-limit message with a Buka Langganan (open subscription) link appears, add outlets to your plan in the Subscription menu first.

form_warehouse.title: The new outlet's warehouse
form_warehouse.desc: Only when creating an outlet: Nama Gudang (warehouse name, for example Gudang Dago) and Kode Gudang (warehouse code, for example WH-DGO, unique, no spaces). Both are required.

form_buttons.title: Create or cancel
form_buttons.desc: Buat Outlet (create outlet; when editing: Simpan Perubahan, save changes) saves; Batal (cancel) closes the form.
