For security, the app may ask you to type your password again (the Konfirmasi Password page). You then come back to this page — the change was not saved yet, so repeat it and save again.

next.title: After creating an outlet
next.desc:
1. Fill the new outlet's warehouse through Stock Transfers from the central warehouse, or Goods Receiving.
  2. Set its receipt name and address in Settings → Store Profile (choose that outlet first).
  3. Let its cashiers use the outlet: Users → edit the user → Outlet yang Diizinkan (allowed outlets).

intro.title: Payment Gateway Settings
intro.desc: Here you set how customers may pay besides cash. A payment gateway is an online payment company — here Midtrans or Xendit — that collects the customer's money (for example by QRIS, e-wallet, or card) and passes it on to your bank account. A small shop only needs Tunai (cash) and Transfer Bank; fill in Midtrans or Xendit only if you already have an account with them.

outlet.title: Saved per outlet
outlet.desc: Payment settings are saved for the outlet shown here. Have several outlets? Choose the outlet you want to set up first, then change its settings. While your cashier shift is open, the outlet choice is locked to that shift's outlet.

readonly.title: View only
readonly.desc: This yellow box appears when your account may only view. Changing payment settings needs the payment-settings-update permission (permission to change payment settings). Ask the store owner to give you that permission, or to make the change.

default.title: Gateway Default
default.desc: The payment method that is already selected when the cashier screen opens. Choose Tunai (cash) if most customers pay cash — the cashier can still pick another method during a sale. Midtrans and Xendit can only be chosen after you activate them below (until then they say (nonaktif), inactive). Transfer Bank cannot be the default. If the chosen gateway is not ready, the cashier falls back to cash.

bank.title: Transfer Bank (bank transfer)
bank.desc:
The customer transfers money to the store's account. Press the Aktif/Nonaktif (on/off) switch on the right to turn it on or off. How it works:
  1. The cashier picks Transfer Bank and the destination account.
  2. The sale is recorded as pending (waiting for payment).
  3. Once the money has really arrived, mark it paid in Transaction History (the Pending - Konfirmasi button).
At least one active account is needed — press Kelola Rekening Bank → (manage bank accounts).

midtrans.title: Midtrans Snap
midtrans.desc:
Online payment through Midtrans; you need an active Midtrans account. Switch it on (Aktif), then fill in:
  • Server Key — a secret key, like a password; never share it. Once saved it shows as Tersimpan: ••••1234 (saved) — leave the box empty if you do not want to replace it.
  • Client Key — its partner key, which is not secret.
Copy both from the Midtrans dashboard (the Access Keys section). After a sale, the receipt page shows a Pembayaran (payment) button with the payment link for the customer.

mode.title: Mode Produksi: test or real
mode.desc:
• Unticked = Sandbox mode: a test with pretend money, good for trying out the payment flow.
  • Ticked = Production mode: customers pay with real money.
The Sandbox keys and the Production keys in the Midtrans dashboard are different — use the pair of keys that matches this tick.

xendit.title: Xendit Invoice
xendit.desc:
An alternative to Midtrans; you need a Xendit account. Once Aktif (on), fill in all three:
  • Secret Key — a secret key, never share it.
  • Public Key — its partner key; without it Xendit does not appear at the cashier.
  • Callback Token — the verification code from the webhook settings in the Xendit dashboard, so payment notices from Xendit are accepted.
Test or real money depends on the key: xnd_development keys are for testing, xnd_production keys take real money.

webhook.title: Webhook URLs
webhook.desc: A webhook is the address Midtrans/Xendit calls to tell the app that the customer has paid, so the sale turns paid by itself. Press Salin (copy), then paste it into the Midtrans dashboard (Notification URL) or the Xendit dashboard (Callback URL). The address must be reachable from the internet; a yellow box appears when the app address is still localhost or the Xendit token is missing.

submit.title: Simpan Konfigurasi (Save Configuration)
submit.desc: Changes only take effect after you press this button. For security, the app may ask you to type your password again (the Konfirmasi Password page). You then come back to this page — the change was not saved yet, so repeat it and save again. Accounts that sign in with an Aishii account press Konfirmasi dengan akun Aishii (confirm with Aishii account). The confirmation lasts about 15 minutes.

intro.title: Price List Items
intro.desc: This page lists the items and their special prices in one price list — its name is in the title, for example Harga Grosir. Items not listed here are still sold at the normal price to this price list's customer group.

back.title: Back
back.desc: This arrow button goes back to the Price Lists page.

add.title: Tambah Harga (add a price)
add.desc: Type part of an item's name in the Cari produk... (search product) box; matching items that are not on the list yet appear with their normal price. Tap the item — a small Harga untuk … (price for …) box opens with the normal price. Replace it with the special price, digits only without dots, for example 4500 (typing 4.500 would be read as 4 rupiah), then press OK. If asked for your password, repeat this step afterwards.

row.title: Item and its special price
row.desc: The item name, its SKU code (- when empty) • Harga normal (normal price), then the purple number on the right = the special price the cashier uses for this price list's customer group.

delete.title: Remove from the price list
delete.desc: Takes the item off this price list after a confirmation; it goes back to the normal price for this group. To change a special price: remove the row, then add the item again with the new price.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: This price list has no items yet. Search for an item in the Tambah Harga (add a price) box above to add the first special price.

intro.title: Price Lists
intro.desc: A price list is a set of special prices for a group of customers, for example Harga Grosir (wholesale prices) for registered customers, or member prices. During a sale the cashier automatically uses the prices of the list that fits the customer; items not on the list keep their normal price. Only one price list is used per sale.

outlet.title: Price lists per outlet
outlet.desc: A new price list applies to the outlet shown here. This page lists the price lists for all outlets plus those of the selected outlet.

new.title: Baru (New)
new.desc: Opens the form for a new price list under the title. Fill in its name and group, save, then press the eye icon on that price list to enter its item prices.

form_name.title: Nama and Slug (required)
form_name.desc: Nama (name) is shown in the list, for example Harga Grosir. Slug is a short code without spaces that no other price list may use, for example harga-grosir. The slug cannot be changed after saving.

form_scope.title: Kelompok (customer group)
form_scope.desc:
Who gets these prices:
  • Semua Pelanggan (all customers) — every sale.
  • Walk-in — walk-in buyers; for now it also applies to registered customers, the same as all customers.
  • Terdaftar (registered) — sales where a customer is chosen.
  • Member — customers who are loyalty members.

form_priority.title: Prioritas (priority)
form_priority.desc: When several price lists fit, the one with the highest priority number is used (lists for a specific outlet always come first). Give the more specific group the bigger number, for example Member = 10 and Semua Pelanggan (all customers) = 1 — the other way round, members would get the all-customer prices.

form_notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
form_notes.desc: A note for yourself, for example prices for resellers. Not shown at the cashier.

form_buttons.title: Save or cancel
form_buttons.desc: Simpan (save; when editing: Update) saves the price list; Batal (cancel) closes the form. For security, the app may ask you to type your password again (the Konfirmasi Password page). You then come back to this page — the change was not saved yet, so repeat it and save again.

row.title: One price list
row.desc: The price list name and its slug (in brackets), then: customer group • how many items have a special price • the priority number.

open.title: Item prices (eye icon)
open.desc: Opens this price list to add items and set their special prices.

edit.title: Edit (pencil icon)
edit.desc: Opens the form above the list to change the name, group, priority, or notes. The slug cannot be changed.

delete.title: Delete (bin icon)
delete.desc: Deletes the price list and all its special prices after a confirmation. This cannot be undone — that group goes back to normal prices.

empty.title: No price lists yet
empty.desc: There are no special prices yet. Press Baru (new) to create the first price list.

intro.title: Printer Settings
intro.desc: Settings for a thermal printer — the small receipt printer with a paper roll. Set the paper size and automatic printing, then connect the USB printer to the cashier computer. Do this on every cashier computer. No USB printer? Receipts can still be printed with the normal print button on the receipt page.

outlet.title: Saved per outlet
outlet.desc: Paper size and automatic printing are saved for the outlet shown here. The printer connection itself is kept in each computer's browser.

paper.title: Ukuran Kertas (paper size)
paper.desc: Choose the width of your printer's paper roll: 80 mm (wide, common in shops and minimarkets) or 58 mm (small, common on portable printers). The width is written on the roll's packaging or on the printer.

auto.title: Cetak otomatis setelah transaksi (auto-print)
auto.desc: When ticked, the receipt prints by itself as soon as the receipt page opens after a sale — as long as the USB printer is connected in this browser. For cash payments, a cash drawer attached to the printer also opens by itself.

device.title: Hubungkan Printer (Connect Printer)
device.desc: Plug the printer's USB cable into the computer, press Hubungkan Printer, then choose the printer from the list that appears. Once connected you get Test Print, Buka Laci (Kick) (open the cash drawer), and Putuskan (disconnect). Use Chrome or Edge on a computer (Safari and Firefox cannot). Each time the browser is reopened, press Hubungkan Printer again so automatic printing works.

submit.title: Simpan Pengaturan (Save Settings)
submit.desc: Saves the paper size and the auto-print choice. The printer connection does not need saving — it works in this browser straight away.

intro.title: Store Settings
intro.desc: Your store's identity printed on receipts and invoices: name, logo, address, and phone number. Fill it in once when you start, then update it if the store moves or changes number. Example: Kedai Kopi Senja, Jl. Merdeka No. 10, Bandung. Only Nama Toko (store name) and Alamat Lengkap (full address) are required.

outlet.title: Profile per outlet
outlet.desc: Name, logo, address, city, phone, email, and website are saved for the outlet shown here, so each branch can print its own address on receipts. NPWP, NIB, and the VAT rate apply to all outlets. Choose the outlet before changing its profile (it is locked while your cashier shift is open).

logo.title: Logo Toko (store logo, optional)
logo.desc: Press the file button (Choose File) and pick your logo picture, 2 MB at most. The preview shows in the box straight away, but it is only saved after Simpan Profil (save profile). The logo appears on the invoice on screen and in PDF, in the top-left corner of the app, and on the cashier screen. Thermal printer receipts are text only.

name.title: Nama Toko (store name, required)
name.desc: The name printed at the top of every receipt, also shown in the top-left corner of the app and on the cashier screen. Example: Kedai Kopi Senja.

address.title: Alamat Lengkap (full address, required)
address.desc: Printed under the store name on receipts. Write it in full so customers can find the store, for example Jl. Merdeka No. 10, Sukajadi, Bandung.

city_phone.title: City and phone (optional)
city_phone.desc: Nomor Telepon (phone number) is printed on receipts so customers can contact the store, for example 0812-3456-7890. Kota/Kabupaten (city/regency) is kept as store information, for example Surabaya.

email_web.title: Email and website (optional)
email_web.desc: Shown on the invoice under the address. Website / Sosial Media (website / social media) can be your Instagram or store page, for example https://instagram.com/kedaisenja. The email must be a valid address, for example hello@yourstore.com.

legal.title: NPWP and NIB (optional)
legal.desc:
• NPWP — your business tax number (Nomor Pokok Wajib Pajak).
  • NIB — your business licence number from the OSS system (Nomor Induk Berusaha).
For now both are only kept as records and are not printed on receipts. They apply to all outlets.

tax.title: Tarif PPN Default (default VAT rate, %)
tax.desc: PPN is the value-added tax (VAT) charged to customers. Note: the tax at the cashier comes from each item's own Persentase Pajak (tax percentage, set in the product form; new items start at 11). The number here is only a fallback for an item without a rate of its own. Stores that do not charge VAT: set the items' Persentase Pajak to 0.

submit.title: Simpan Profil (Save Profile)
submit.desc: Press to save. The message Profil toko disimpan (store profile saved) appears when it works; if a field is wrong, red text appears under it. The next receipts use the new details straight away.

intro.title: Sales Target
intro.desc: Set how many rupiah of sales you aim for each month. The Dashboard then shows how close this month's sales are to that target. Example: a shop that usually sells Rp 12 million a month could set a target of Rp 15 million.

outlet.title: Target per outlet
outlet.desc: The target is saved for the outlet shown here, so every branch can have its own target. Choose the outlet before changing its target (it is locked while your cashier shift is open).

input.title: Target Penjualan Bulanan (monthly sales target)
input.desc: Type the number only, without dots, for example 15000000 for Rp 15 million. The line Target: Rp 15.000.000 under it helps you check the zeros. Then press Enter (on a phone: the Enter/Go key on the keyboard) to save — the message Target berhasil disimpan (target saved) appears. Enter 0 if you do not want a target.

tip.title: Shown on the Dashboard
tip.desc: On the Dashboard, the Target Bulan Ini (this month's target) box shows the percentage: total sales since the 1st of this month divided by the target. The count starts from zero every new month; the target stays the same until you change it.

intro.title: Units
intro.desc: The list of item units: pcs, box, carton, kg, and so on. They are used for items sold in more than one unit — for example instant noodles sold per PCS and per DUS (carton) of 40. How many are in a carton (1 DUS = 40 PCS) and the price per unit are set in each item's form; this page only lists the unit names. It applies to all outlets.

add.title: Tambah Satuan (Add Unit)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new unit under the list.

row.title: One unit
row.desc: The unit name with its symbol (purple label), then its code and how many items use it, for example BOX • dipakai 3 produk (used by 3 products).

actions.title: Edit or delete
actions.desc: The pencil edits the unit; the form opens under the list. The bin deletes the unit after a confirmation — it only appears when no item uses the unit.

empty.title: No units yet
empty.desc: Press Tambah Satuan (add unit) to create the first one, for example PCS.

form_code.title: Kode (code, required)
form_code.desc: A short unique code, 10 characters at most, for example DUS. This code is what shows in the product form and on the unit buttons of the cashier screen.

form_name.title: Nama Satuan (unit name, required)
form_name.desc: Its full name, for example Carton or Kilogram.

form_symbol.title: Simbol (symbol, required)
form_symbol.desc: A short abbreviation, 10 characters at most, for example dus or kg. Shown as the purple label in this list.

form_buttons.title: Save or cancel
form_buttons.desc: Simpan (save; when editing: Update) saves the unit; Batal (cancel) closes the form without saving.

next.title: Using units on an item
next.desc: Open Products, edit the item, then in the Satuan (units) section press + Tambah Satuan (add unit): choose the unit code, fill in Konversi (conversion, for example 1 DUS = 40), the selling price, and its barcode if any.

intro.title: Warehouses / Branches
intro.desc: A warehouse is a place where stock is kept and counted separately. Every outlet has its own warehouse, and stock is recorded per warehouse — for example 20 packs of coffee in the central warehouse and 5 in a branch warehouse. Stock moves between warehouses through Stock Transfers. Opening a new branch that sells? Create it in the Outlets menu — its warehouse is created with it.

add.title: Tambah Gudang (Add Warehouse)
add.desc: Opens the form for a new warehouse under the list. A new warehouse starts with every item at stock 0; fill it through Goods Receiving or Stock Transfers.

list.title: Daftar Gudang (warehouse list)
list.desc: Every active warehouse you may manage; the number in the title is how many there are.

row.title: One warehouse
row.desc: The warehouse name with its code underneath — for example Gudang Pusat with the code PUSAT.

actions.title: Edit or delete
actions.desc:
• Pencil — edit the warehouse; the form opens under the list. Check every field again, including Tipe (type), address, and phone, before pressing Update.
  • Bin — delete the warehouse after a confirmation. Only possible for a warehouse with zero stock that was never used; the main warehouse cannot be deleted. Otherwise make it inactive — inactive warehouses no longer show in this list.

empty.title: No warehouses yet
empty.desc: Press Tambah Gudang (add warehouse) to create the first one.

form_main.title: Code, name, type
form_main.desc:
• Kode (code, required) — a short unique code, for example WH-002; it cannot be changed after saving.
  • Nama Gudang (warehouse name, required) — for example Back Storeroom.
  • Tipe (type) — just a label: Cabang (branch) for a selling branch's warehouse, Gudang (warehouse) for storage.

form_extra.title: Address, phone, order, active
form_extra.desc:
• Alamat (address) and Telepon (phone) — optional.
  • Urutan (order) — the warehouse's position in lists; smaller numbers come first, for example 1.
  • Aktif (active) — untick to stop using the warehouse. Not possible while a cashier shift is still open in it.

form_buttons.title: Save or cancel
form_buttons.desc: Simpan (save; when editing: Update) saves the warehouse; Batal (cancel) closes the form without saving.

intro.title: WhatsApp Gateway
intro.desc: Links one WhatsApp number to the app so that CRM Campaign messages (offers, reminders) are sent to customers' numbers automatically. It needs a separate WhatsApp service running on a server — usually installed by a technician. The order: fill in the URL Service and save → Hubungkan WhatsApp (connect) and scan the QR → tick Aktifkan (enable) and save.

outlet.title: Saved per outlet
outlet.desc: WhatsApp settings are saved for the outlet shown here, so each branch can use its own WhatsApp service and number.

status.title: Connection status
status.desc:
• Terputus (disconnected, grey dot) — not linked yet, or the WhatsApp service cannot be reached.
  • Menghubungkan... (connecting, yellow) — waiting for the QR code to be scanned.
  • Terhubung (number) (connected, green) — ready to send.

connect.title: Hubungkan WhatsApp (Connect WhatsApp)
connect.desc: Asks the WhatsApp service to prepare a QR code. Make sure the URL Service below is filled in and saved first — this button uses the saved address. If no QR code appears, check the address or contact your technician.

qr.title: Scan the QR code
qr.desc: On the phone, open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then point the camera at this QR code. The status changes to Terhubung (connected) by itself.

disconnect.title: Putuskan Koneksi (Disconnect)
disconnect.desc: Unlinks the WhatsApp number from the app. Automatic messages stop until you connect again.

url.title: URL Service WhatsApp (service address)
url.desc: The address of the WhatsApp service, for example http://localhost:3001 when the service runs on the same server as the app. Ask the technician who installed the service for it. Leave it empty if the store does not use a WhatsApp gateway.

enable.title: Aktifkan WhatsApp Gateway (enable)
enable.desc: Ticked (and the status Terhubung, connected) = CRM Campaign messages are sent automatically through this number when a campaign is processed. Unticked, nothing is sent through the gateway; campaign messages can still be sent one by one through WhatsApp links.

auto.title: Kirim Otomatis (send automatically)
auto.desc: Two choices: Kirim reminder piutang otomatis (automatic reminders of customer debts) and Kirim invoice setelah transaksi (send the invoice after a sale). Note: in this version of the app both are only saved as preferences — the messages actually sent automatically are CRM Campaign messages.

submit.title: Simpan Pengaturan (Save Settings)
submit.desc: Saves the URL and all the ticks above. The message Pengaturan WhatsApp disimpan (WhatsApp settings saved) appears when it works.

test.title: Test Kirim Pesan (send a test message)
test.desc: Appears once connected. Type your own number, for example 081234567890, and press Kirim (send). Check WhatsApp on that phone — the test only counts as working if the message really arrives.

intro.title: Mutasi Stok (Stock Mutations)
intro.desc: A mutation is a change of stock. This page is your stock logbook: every time an item's stock goes up or down — sold, delivered by a supplier, returned, moved between warehouses, or corrected by a stock opname — one row is recorded here, and it cannot be edited. Open it when a stock number looks wrong, for example to find out when and why your coffee stock dropped.

filters.title: Filter the history
filters.desc:
The list updates as soon as you choose:
  • Semua Produk (all products) — pick one item to see only its history.
  • Semua Tipe (all types) — only In, Out, or Adjustment.
  • Semua Gudang (all warehouses) — only changes in one warehouse.
  • Two date boxes — the first is from, the second is until. Clear them to see everything.

list.title: Histori Mutasi Stok (history)
list.desc:
One row = one stock change, newest first:
  • Produk (product) — the item's name and its barcode or SKU.
  • Qty — how much changed, in the item's basic unit (e.g. pcs).
  • Dibuat Oleh (by) and Waktu (time) — who did it and when; a dash (-) when the system recorded it automatically.
The other columns are explained next. On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see every column.

type.title: Tipe (type of change)
type.desc:
• in — stock went up, e.g. goods delivered by a supplier or returned by a customer.
  • out — stock went down, e.g. sold or sent to another warehouse.
  • adjustment — stock corrected by a stock opname (recount). Its Qty is always positive; check Before / After to see whether stock went up or down.

before_after.title: Before / After
before_after.desc: The stock before → after this change. Example: 24 → 22 means stock went down by 2. Reading one item's rows from the bottom up lets you trace how its stock changed over time.

warehouse.title: Gudang (warehouse)
warehouse.desc: The warehouse where the stock changed. The app keeps stock per warehouse: each outlet (a branch where you sell) has its own warehouse, and PUSAT is the central warehouse, which does not sell. So a sale at one outlet only lowers that outlet's warehouse stock. A dash (-) means the row is not tied to a particular warehouse.

ref.title: Referensi (where it came from)
ref.desc:
The bold code says where the change came from; the small text below gives details, such as the receipt number:
  • transaction — a sale at the cashier.
  • dine_order — a dine-in order.
  • transaction_expire — a sale cancelled automatically because the online payment never came; stock returned.
  • product_create — opening stock when the item was registered.
  • goods_receiving — goods delivered by a supplier.
  • supplier_return — returned to a supplier.
  • sales_return — returned by a customer.
  • stock_opname — a recount correction.
  • stock_transfer — moved between warehouses.

empty.title: Nothing recorded
empty.desc: No stock changes recorded yet — or none match the filters. Try Semua Produk, Semua Tipe, and Semua Gudang, and clear the dates. Rows appear by themselves with every sale, delivery, return, transfer, or stock opname.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many rows are split over several pages. Press a page number or the arrows to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page (10, 25, or 50).

intro.title: Stock Opname
intro.desc: Stock Opname means recounting the goods actually on your shelves or in your storeroom and matching them with the stock the app has on record. Do it, say, once a month, or when you suspect items went missing or got damaged. Example: the app says 24 bottles of tea, the shelf holds only 22 — the opname corrects the record to 22. Each count is saved as a session. Start with Buat Sesi Opname (create opname session).

new.title: Buat Sesi Opname (new session)
new.desc: Starts a new count. You choose the warehouse to count, then the session page opens where you add items and what you counted. Creating a session does not change any stock yet. This button only appears if you are allowed to create stock opnames.

filters.title: Filter the sessions
filters.desc:
The list updates as soon as you type or choose:
  • Cari kode sesi... (search session code) — type a session code (e.g. SO-2026) or a bit of its notes.
  • Semua Status (all statuses) — show only Draft or only Finalized sessions.
  • Semua Gudang (all warehouses) — show one warehouse's sessions.
  • Two date boxes — left is from, right is until the date the session was created. Clear them to see everything.

list.title: Daftar Sesi Stock Opname (sessions)
list.desc:
One row = one counting session:
  • Kode (code) — the session number and its notes.
  • Status — Draft (yellow): counting in progress, numbers can still change, stock not touched yet. Finalized (green): locked, and the stock has been corrected.
  • Jumlah Item (items) — how many items the session holds.
  • Dibuat Oleh (created by) and Finalized — who created it, then who locked it and when.
Each session's warehouse is not shown here — use the Semua Gudang filter. On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see the other columns.

row.title: Open a session
row.desc: Press the eye icon at the right end of the row to open the session. There you add items, type what you counted, and lock (finalize) the session. Finalized sessions can still be opened to see the result, but can no longer be changed.

empty.title: No sessions yet
empty.desc: No counting sessions yet — or none match the filters above. Press Buat Sesi Opname (create opname session) to start one, or clear the filters.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many sessions are split over several pages. Press a page number or the arrows to move between them, and choose how many sessions show per page (10, 25, or 50).

intro.title: Buat Sesi Stock Opname (new session)
intro.desc: Here you open a stock recount session for one warehouse. The app keeps stock per warehouse: each outlet (a branch where you sell) has its own warehouse, and PUSAT is the central warehouse, which does not sell. So one session = one place whose goods you count. Creating a session does not change stock yet.

warehouse.title: Gudang / Cabang (warehouse)
warehouse.desc: Choose the warehouse whose goods you will count. Counting the shop shelves? Choose that shop's warehouse, for example Gudang Toko Utama — not PUSAT. Careful: it starts on the first warehouse in the list (usually PUSAT). The warehouse cannot be changed after the session is created. Only warehouses you are allowed to manage appear.

notes.title: Catatan Sesi (notes, optional)
notes.desc: A note to remember this count by, for example End-of-month count, drinks shelf, Toko Utama. It helps to write the warehouse name too, because the session list does not show the warehouse. You can still change the note on the session page while it is a Draft.

submit.title: Buat Sesi (create)
submit.desc: Press Buat Sesi (create session). The new Draft session opens straight away: add the items you count, type how many are really there, then finalize. The guide on that page explains each step. Changed your mind? Press Kembali ke daftar stock opname (back to the list) at the top.

intro.title: Stock Opname session
intro.desc:
On this page you record what you counted. The order:
  1. Press Tambah Produk (add product) and pick the items you count.
  2. Count each item and type the number under Stok Fisik (physical stock).
  3. If it differs from the record, fill in Alasan (reason).
  4. Press the floppy-disk button on that row to save it.
  5. When everything is done, press Finalize Stock Opname.
The stock in the app only changes at the last step.

header.title: Session code and status
header.desc: The session code, who created it, and when. The Draft label (yellow) means the session is still open: you can add items and change numbers, and stock has not been touched. After finalizing, the label becomes Finalized (green) and the session is locked. The counted warehouse's name is not shown on this page; it was chosen when the session was created.

summary.title: Count summary
summary.desc:
• Total Item — how many items are in this session.
  • Item Sesuai (matching) — items whose count equals the record.
  • Item Selisih (different) — items whose count differs.
  • Total Adjustment — all the differences added up. Plus (+) means more goods than recorded, minus (-) means fewer.
Items not counted yet are left out of these numbers.

add.title: Tambah Produk (add product)
add.desc: Opens a search window. Type an item's name, barcode, or SKU (item code), wait 1–2 seconds for the results, then press Tambah (add) on the item you are counting. At that moment the app notes the item's Stok Sistem (system stock) in this warehouse. Items already in the session do not show up again. (The stock number in the search window is the total of all warehouses.)

items.title: The counted items
items.desc:
• Produk (product) — the item's name, category, and barcode or SKU.
  • Stok Sistem (system stock) — the app's record when the item was added to the session.
  • Stok Fisik (physical stock) — what you actually counted.
  • Selisih (difference) — the gap, worked out for you.
  • Alasan (reason) — why it differs.
  • Simpan (save) — the floppy-disk button that saves that row.
The next steps show how to fill in one row. If the table is cut off, scroll it sideways to see the columns on the right.

physical.title: Stok Fisik (physical stock)
physical.desc: Count the item on the shelf or in the storeroom, then type the number here in the item's basic unit (e.g. pcs, not boxes). Example: type 22. Type 0 if none are left.

difference.title: Selisih (difference)
difference.desc:
Worked out for you: Stok Fisik minus Stok Sistem. Example: record 24, counted 22 → -2 (2 short).
  • Grey Belum dihitung (not counted) — no physical count typed yet.
  • Green 0 — matches the record.
  • Yellow + or - — differs; fill in the Alasan (reason) next to it.

reason.title: Alasan (reason for a difference)
reason.desc: The Alasan (reason) column is to the right of Selisih — if you can't see it, scroll the table sideways (on a computer: hold Shift while turning the mouse wheel). Required when the count differs from the record; the box then says Wajib isi alasan (reason required). Briefly write the cause, e.g. 2 bottles broken. No difference: leave it empty. A row with a difference but no reason is not saved.

save.title: Save this row
save.desc: The floppy-disk button is in the Simpan (save) column, at the far right of the table. Press it each time you finish one row, before typing in another: when a row is saved the table reloads, and numbers typed in other rows but not yet saved are lost. The message Item opname diperbarui (item updated) means it worked. Saving a row does not change stock yet.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: This session is still empty. Press Tambah Produk (add product) above the table to add the first item to count. An empty session cannot be finalized.

notes.title: Catatan Sesi (session notes)
notes.desc: Notes about this session, for example who counted or which shelves. Change the text and press Simpan Catatan (save notes). After the session is finalized, the notes can no longer be changed.

finalize.title: Finalize Stock Opname
finalize.desc: The last step — it cannot be undone and runs at once, with no confirmation question. Each counted item's stock in this warehouse is replaced with its Stok Fisik number, and the session is locked. Belum dihitung (not counted) items are skipped and keep their stock. Before pressing, make sure every row is saved and nothing was sold since you counted. The button is faded when the session is empty or a difference lacks a reason.

next.title: After finalizing
next.desc: Every stock change from this session is recorded in the Stock Mutations menu with type adjustment and reference stock_opname, showing the stock before and after. Miscounted something after locking? Create a new opname session for that item.

intro.title: Session already Finalized
intro.desc: This counting session is locked. When it was finalized, each counted item's stock in its warehouse was replaced with the count (Stok Fisik); items not counted were left alone. The page is now view-only — nothing can be changed or undone.

header.title: Who and when
header.desc: The session code, the green Finalized label, who created the session, and the Difinalisasi oleh (finalized by) line — who locked it and when the stock was corrected.

summary.title: Count result
summary.desc:
• Total Item — how many items are in this session.
  • Item Sesuai (matching) — the count matched the record.
  • Item Selisih (different) — the count differed, and the stock has been corrected.
  • Total Adjustment — all the differences added up. Minus (-) means goods went down (missing, damaged), plus (+) means more than recorded.

items.title: Item by item
items.desc: Stok Sistem (system stock) is the app's record when the item was added, Stok Fisik (physical stock) the count that is now the warehouse's stock, Selisih the difference, and Alasan the reason. Belum dihitung (not counted) rows did not change stock. The boxes are faded because the session is locked. If the table is cut off, scroll it sideways.

notes.title: Catatan Sesi (session notes)
notes.desc: The notes written while the session was open. Since it is Finalized, they can only be read.

next.title: Checking the stock changes
next.desc: You can see this session's stock changes in the Stock Mutations menu: type adjustment, reference stock_opname, with the stock before → after. Miscounted something? This session cannot be reopened — create a new opname session for that item.

intro.title: Transfer Stok (Stock Transfers)
intro.desc: For moving goods from one warehouse to another. Stock is kept per warehouse, and the cashier only sells from the warehouse of the outlet where their shift is open. Example: goods from the supplier arrive at PUSAT (the central warehouse, which does not sell) — send 24 bottles to the shop's warehouse so the cashier can sell them. A transfer takes two steps: it is sent from the source warehouse, then received at the destination.

new.title: Transfer Baru (new transfer)
new.desc: Records a new move: choose the source and destination warehouses, then the items and quantities. It is saved only as a Draft — stock does not move until you press Kirim Barang (send goods) on its detail page. This button appears if you are allowed to create transfers.

list.title: Daftar Transfer Stok (transfers)
list.desc:
One row = one move of goods:
  • Dokumen (document) — the transfer number, e.g. ST-20261015-0001.
  • Asal (from) → Tujuan (to) — the sending and receiving warehouses.
  • Status — Draft: recorded only, stock has not moved. In Transit: on the way — stock has left the source but not reached the destination. Selesai (done): received, stock added at the destination. Batal (cancelled).
  • Item — how many different items; Dibuat (created) — when it was recorded.

row.title: Open a transfer
row.desc: Press the eye icon at the right end of the row to open the transfer. Its page has the buttons to move it along: Kirim Barang (send goods) while it is a Draft, Terima Barang (receive goods) while In Transit, or the buttons to cancel it. On a phone, swipe the table sideways to find the eye icon.

empty.title: No transfers yet
empty.desc: Goods have never been moved between warehouses yet. Press Transfer Baru (new transfer) to record the first one — for example, stocking the shop's warehouse from PUSAT.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many transfers are split over several pages. Press a page number or the arrows to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page (10, 25, or 50).

intro.title: Transfer Stok Baru (new transfer)
intro.desc: This form records goods to be moved from one warehouse to another. Required: Gudang Asal (from), Gudang Tujuan (to), and at least one item. Saving this form does not move stock yet: the transfer is saved as a Draft, and stock only moves when you press Kirim Barang (send goods) on its detail page.

source.title: Gudang Asal (from)
source.desc: The warehouse that sends the goods — its stock goes down when the transfer is sent. Example: PUSAT — Gudang Pusat. Make sure it holds enough of each item; otherwise sending will be refused later. Required.

destination.title: Gudang Tujuan (to)
destination.desc: The warehouse that receives the goods, for example the shop's warehouse where the cashier sells. The source warehouse is left out of this list, because source and destination must differ. Required. Only warehouses you are allowed to manage appear.

number.title: Nomor Dokumen (number, optional)
number.desc: Leave it empty — the app makes the number itself, e.g. ST-20261015-0001 (ST = stock transfer, then the date and a running number). Fill it in only if you have your own delivery-note number: at most 30 characters, and not the same as another transfer's number.

notes.title: Catatan (notes, optional)
notes.desc: Extra notes, for example stock for the weekend or who is delivering. Shown on the transfer's detail page.

search.title: Find and add items
search.desc: Type part of an item's name or its SKU, e.g. aqua. Matching items appear under this box; press the one you are moving to add it to the table (starting at 1). Repeat for other items. The Stok number in that list is the total of all warehouses, not just the source warehouse.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: Items you pick from the search appear here. A transfer cannot be saved without at least one item.

items.title: How many to move
items.desc: Type the quantity under Qty in the item's basic unit (e.g. pcs), at least 1. The box cannot be emptied: to change the number, first select the number that is there, then type the new one — otherwise the 1 stays in front (25 becomes 125). The bin button removes the item from the list.

actions.title: Simpan Draft (save draft)
actions.desc: Simpan Draft (save draft) saves the transfer as a Draft and opens its detail page — stock does not change yet. There, press Kirim Barang (send goods) when the goods actually leave. Batal (cancel) goes back to the list without saving. If something is missing, a message tells you what.

intro.title: Stock transfer details
intro.desc:
The page of one move of goods. Its journey:
  1. Draft — recorded, stock has not moved.
  2. Press Kirim Barang (send goods) when the goods leave → In Transit: stock leaves the source warehouse.
  3. Press Terima Barang (receive goods) when they arrive → Selesai (done): stock enters the destination warehouse.
The buttons shown on this page depend on the current status.

status.title: Transfer status
status.desc:
• Draft — a draft; stock in both warehouses is unchanged.
  • In Transit — on the way: stock has gone down at the source but not yet up at the destination, so meanwhile the goods cannot be sold from any warehouse.
  • Selesai (done) — received; stock went up at the destination.
  • Batal (cancelled).
Done or cancelled transfers have no buttons left.

info.title: Detail Transfer (details)
info.desc: Gudang Asal (sending warehouse), Gudang Tujuan (receiving warehouse), who recorded it and when, and the Catatan (notes). The Selesai (done) date appears once the goods are received.

items.title: Item Transfer (items)
items.desc: The items being moved and their quantity (Qty, in basic units such as pcs). This list can no longer be changed. Something wrong? Cancel this transfer while it is not yet done, then create a new transfer.

send.title: Kirim Barang (send goods)
send.desc: Press it when the goods actually leave, then answer OK to the confirmation. Each item's stock immediately goes down at the source warehouse and the status becomes In Transit. If the source lacks enough of any item, the whole sending is refused and the status stays Draft. Appears if you are allowed to send transfers.

cancel.title: Batalkan (cancel)
cancel.desc: Cancels a transfer that has not been sent (answer OK to the confirmation). Stock does not change at all, since the goods never left. The status becomes Batal (cancelled) and this transfer cannot be used again — to try again, create a new transfer.

receive.title: Terima Barang (receive goods)
receive.desc: Press it after the goods arrive and you have checked the quantities, then answer OK. Each item's stock goes up at the destination warehouse by its Qty, the status becomes Selesai (done), and the goods can be sold there. It cannot be undone, and quantities cannot be changed when receiving — fix missing or damaged goods with a Stock Opname at the destination.

return.title: Batalkan & Kembalikan (cancel and return)
return.desc: For goods that never arrived or were brought back. After you answer OK, each item's stock is returned to the source warehouse and the status becomes Batal (cancelled). It cannot be repeated: if needed, send again with a new transfer.

next.title: Checking the result
next.desc: Every sending and receiving is recorded in the Stock Mutations menu with reference stock_transfer: out at the source when sent, in at the destination when received.

intro.title: Supplier Returns
intro.desc: The list of goods you send back to suppliers, for example because they are damaged, expired, or the wrong item. A return reduces stock when it is marked Selesai (completed). Example: 3 packs of bread from the wholesaler went mouldy and the driver takes them back. Start by pressing Buat Retur (create return).

add.title: Buat Retur (create return)
add.desc: Opens a new return form: choose the supplier, then the items, quantities, and reasons. A new return is saved as a Draft — stock does not change until the return is completed. This button appears if you are allowed to create returns.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.desc: Type a return number (for example SR-20261015-0001; SR = Supplier Return), or pick a status and a supplier to show only some returns. The list updates straight away.

list.title: Return list
list.desc:
Each row is one return: Dokumen (return number and date created), Supplier, Status, Item (number of different items), Tanggal (date completed, or date created if not completed), and Dibuat Oleh (created by).
  • Draft — recorded, stock not reduced yet.
  • Selesai (completed) — goods sent back, stock reduced.
  • Dibatalkan (cancelled) — not going ahead, stock unchanged.

row.title: Open a return
row.desc: Press the eye button at the right end of the row to open the return. That is where a Draft return is completed or cancelled. On a phone, swipe the table left first.

empty.title: No returns yet
empty.desc: No returns yet, or none match your search and filters. Goods to send back to a supplier? Press Buat Retur (create return).

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many returns are split over several pages. Use the page numbers to move between them, and choose how many rows show per page.

intro.title: Create a Supplier Return
intro.desc: The form to record goods sent back to a supplier. Required: the supplier and at least one item. The return is saved as a Draft — stock only goes down after you press Selesaikan Retur (complete return) on its detail page.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.desc: Choose the supplier taking the goods back. Changing the supplier clears the items already added, so choose the supplier first.

gr.title: Penerimaan Barang (receiving, optional)
gr.desc: If the goods came from a particular delivery, choose its receiving number (GR-…): that delivery's items appear below to add with one press at their PO price, and the stock is taken from that delivery's warehouse. Available after choosing the supplier. Only Tidak terkait GR (not linked to a GR) to choose? Skip it and search for the items in the search box.

notes.title: Catatan (note, optional)
notes.desc: A note for the whole return, for example Collected by the supplier's driver on Monday.

gr_items.title: Item dari GR (receiving items)
gr_items.desc: Items from the chosen receiving, with their PO prices. Press each item you want to return (marked + Tambah, add); it moves into the table below.

search.title: Find items
search.desc: Type an item name or SKU (your store's own item code), then press the item that appears to add it. The price is filled in from the item's purchase price. Each item can be added only once.

items.title: Item Retur (items to return)
items.desc:
• Qty — how many you send back, at least 1.
  • Harga (price) — value per item, used to work out the return's value.
  • Subtotal — Qty × Harga.
  • Alasan (reason, optional) — for example Damaged packaging or Expired.
  • Bin button — removes the item from the list.
The Total below is the value of everything returned.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.desc: The return has no items yet. Choose the supplier, then add items from a receiving (GR) or through the search box above.

submit.title: Save the return
submit.desc: Press Simpan Retur (save return). The return is saved as a Draft with an automatic number (SR-date-sequence); stock does not change yet and its contents can no longer be edited. Hand the goods to the supplier, then press Selesaikan Retur (complete return) on its detail page. Batal (cancel) goes back without saving.

intro.title: Supplier return details
intro.desc: The page for one return: which items go back, how many, their value, and why. A Draft return is completed here once the goods have actually been handed to the supplier.

header.title: Number and status
header.desc:
The return number and status, then the supplier, who created it, and when. A Diselesaikan (completed on) line appears once it is completed.
  • Draft — stock not reduced yet; can be completed or cancelled.
  • Selesai (completed) — stock has been reduced.
  • Dibatalkan (cancelled) — not going ahead; stock unchanged.

complete.title: Selesaikan Retur (complete return)
complete.desc: Press this after the goods have been handed to the supplier. Each item's stock goes down by the returned quantity and is logged in Stock Mutations. If the Informasi box shows a Hutang Supplier (supplier debt) line, the return's value reduces that debt; otherwise the debt is unchanged. It happens at once, without a confirmation question, and cannot be undone. It fails if an item has less stock than the quantity returned.

cancel.title: Batalkan (cancel)
cancel.desc: Cancels a return that has not been completed, for example because the supplier refuses the goods. The status becomes Dibatalkan (cancelled), stock is unchanged, and you return to the list. It happens immediately without a confirmation question and cannot be undone.

items.title: Item Retur (returned items)
items.desc: The goods going back: Qty Retur (quantity), Harga (price) per item, Subtotal, and Alasan (reason). Total Retur (return total) below is the value of everything returned. On a phone, swipe the table left to see every column.

info.title: Informasi (summary)
info.desc: A summary: number, supplier, date created, and date completed. If the return is linked to a debt, the Hutang Supplier (supplier debt) line shows that debt and what is left — press it to open it.

intro.title: Suppliers Page
intro.desc: A supplier is where you buy your stock, for example an agent, distributor, or wholesaler. Register them here so you can choose them when making a Purchase Order, recording Goods Receiving, and tracking what you owe them (payables).

add.title: Tambah Supplier (Add Supplier)
add.desc: The form below this button is always open for a new supplier. Tambah Supplier (add supplier) only clears the form — use it when you were editing another supplier and want to add a new one again.

name.title: Nama (Name, required)
name.desc: The business or person's name, for example CV Sumber Rejeki or Mr Darto (egg agent). This is the only required field.

phone.title: Telepon (Phone, optional)
phone.desc: The number you call to order goods, for example 081234567890.

email.title: Email (optional)
email.desc: The supplier's email address if any, for example order@sumberrejeki.com. If filled in, it must be a valid email address.

address.title: Alamat (Address, optional)
address.desc: The supplier's warehouse or shop address, for example Pasar Induk Blok C No. 12. Useful when you collect goods yourself.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save) to add the supplier to the list below — the form empties again. When editing a supplier, the button reads Update and a Batal (cancel) button appears to drop the changes.

list.title: Supplier list
list.desc: All suppliers in alphabetical order: name, then phone • email, and address. A - means not filled in.

row.title: Edit or delete a supplier
row.desc: The pencil button copies the supplier's data into the form above — scroll up, change it, then press Update. The bin button deletes after you press OK on Hapus supplier ini? (delete this supplier?). A supplier with payable records cannot be deleted. Their old purchase orders and receipts stay, but without the supplier's name.

empty.title: No suppliers yet
empty.desc: No suppliers registered yet. Fill in the form above — the name is enough — then press Simpan (save).

next.title: Next step
next.desc: Supplier registered? Order goods in the Purchase Orders menu, then record what arrives in Goods Receiving: stock goes up and the amount owed is recorded automatically in Supplier Payables.

intro.title: Riwayat Transaksi (Transaction History)
intro.desc:
A list of every recorded sale, newest first. Open it to find an old receipt, print it again, send it to a customer, or record goods a customer brings back (a return). Example: yesterday's customer asks for the receipt again — look up its number here.

The store owner's account sees every sale; other accounts only see the sales they recorded themselves.

filter.title: Filter
filter.desc:
Press Filter to open the search box:
  • Nomor Invoice (invoice number) — the number printed on the receipt, for example TRX-SVWH28XF. Part of it is enough.
  • Tanggal Mulai and Tanggal Akhir (start and end date) — the range of sale dates.
  • Gudang / Cabang (warehouse / branch) — only sales from that branch.
Then press Cari (Search). A small dot on the Filter button means a filter is in use.

new.title: Transaksi Baru (New Transaction)
new.desc: Opens the cashier screen to record the next sale. If no cashier shift is open yet, you are asked to open one first.

filters.title: Search box
filters.desc: Fill in one or more boxes, then press Cari (Search). Example: to see sales from the 1st to the 7th, fill in Tanggal Mulai and Tanggal Akhir (start and end date). The × button (shown while a filter is in use) clears the search and shows every sale again.

list.title: Sales list
list.desc:
One row (on a phone: one card) is one sale:
  • Invoice — the receipt number.
  • Tanggal (date) — date and time.
  • Kasir (cashier) — who recorded it.
  • Pelanggan (customer) — Umum (walk-in) when no name.
  • Item — number of items.
  • Total — the amount to pay.
Phones also show Pembayaran (payment): how it was paid, for example Cash.

status.title: Payment status
status.desc:
• Lunas (paid, green) — fully paid.
  • Piutang (receivable, yellow) — bought with Bayar Belakangan (pay later) and not settled yet. Payments are recorded in the Receivables menu.
  • Pending - Konfirmasi (phone: Pending) — payment not received yet. For a bank transfer: once the money has really arrived in the store's account, press this label, then Konfirmasi Lunas (confirm paid). This cannot be undone.
  • Red labels: pending_approval = discount awaiting approval, pending = online payment not received, unpaid = not paid, failed = online payment failed.

actions.title: Buttons on each sale
actions.desc:
• Retur (return) — record goods the customer brings back. Retur selesai (return done) = everything has come back.
  • Printer icon / Detail — open the receipt to print it again.
  • WhatsApp icon / Invoice — send or open the invoice PDF for the customer.
  • Bank building icon / Campaign WA — prepare a WhatsApp message in the CRM Campaigns menu.
  • Resi — parcel shipping label (PDF).

empty.title: No transactions yet
empty.desc: No matching sales. If a filter is in use, press Filter and then × to clear it. New store? Record the first sale with Transaksi Baru (New Transaction) and it appears here right away.

pagination.title: More pages
pagination.desc: Many sales are split over several pages. Use the page numbers to see older sales, and Tampilkan (show) to choose 10, 25, or 50 sales per page.

intro.title: Invoice Penjualan (Sales Invoice)
intro.desc:
This page opens by itself every time a sale is finished. From here you print a receipt for the customer, save the invoice as a PDF, or send its link to the customer. You can reopen it any time from Transaction History (the printer icon or Detail).

Example: the customer wants a receipt — choose Struk 80mm (80 mm receipt), then press Thermal.

nav.title: Back to the cashier
nav.desc: Kembali ke kasir (back to the cashier) opens the cashier screen to serve the next customer. The Guided Tour button next to it reopens this guide any time.

modes.title: Choose the document
modes.desc:
• Invoice — a full invoice on ordinary paper (A4) with the store's logo and address. Good for business customers or anyone who asks for a formal invoice.
  • Struk 80mm and Struk 58mm (80 / 58 mm receipt) — a small receipt for a cashier printer. Pick your printer's paper width: 80 mm (common) or 58 mm (small printers).
  • Resi (shipping label) — a parcel label with the recipient's name and address, for delivery orders.
The preview below and the PDF button change to match.

thermal.title: Thermal — print directly
thermal.desc:
Sends the receipt straight to a USB thermal printer (a cashier receipt printer). The paper is 58 mm when Struk 58mm is chosen, otherwise 80 mm. For cash sales, a cash drawer connected to the printer opens too.

Connect the printer once on the Printer Settings page (address /dashboard/settings/printer) using Chrome or Edge. If no printer is connected, the browser's normal print window opens instead — allow pop-ups if asked.

pay_link.title: Pembayaran (pay online)
pay_link.desc: Shown for sales paid through a payment gateway — an online payment service such as Midtrans or Xendit. This button opens its payment page: show it to the customer or send them the link. The invoice turns Lunas (paid) by itself once the payment is received.

qris.title: Scan QRIS
qris.desc: Shown for an unpaid QRIS payment. Ask the customer to scan this code with their banking or e-wallet app (GoPay, OVO, DANA, and so on). The page checks by itself every few seconds; when the money arrives, the message Pembayaran QRIS diterima! (QRIS payment received) appears and the status turns paid.

share.title: Share — a link for the customer
share.desc: Copies a link to this invoice; the message Link invoice disalin (invoice link copied) appears. Open WhatsApp or SMS and paste the link into a message to the customer. The customer can open the purchase details without logging in. For an unpaid pay-later invoice, there is a Bayar Sekarang (pay now) button when online payment is enabled.

confirm.title: Konfirmasi Bayar (confirm payment)
confirm.desc: Shown for a Transfer Bank (bank transfer) sale that has not been checked yet, to users allowed to confirm payments. First check the store account's statement. If the money has arrived, press this button, then Konfirmasi Lunas (confirm paid) — the invoice becomes Lunas (paid). This cannot be undone. If the app asks for your password, enter it, then press the button once more.

pdf.title: Save or print a PDF
pdf.desc: Opens the document as a PDF in a new tab — PDF Invoice, PDF Struk 80mm/58mm (receipt), or PDF Resi (shipping label), matching the choice above. You can print the PDF on an ordinary printer, save it, or send it as a file.

head.title: Invoice header
head.desc: The store's name, address, phone, and logo come from Settings → Store Profile. On the right are the invoice number and the sale date. Use this number to find the invoice in Transaction History.

info.title: Customer, cashier, and status
info.desc:
Pelanggan (customer) — Umum (walk-in) when no customer was chosen. Kasir (cashier) — who recorded the sale. The labels next to it:
  • Payment status: Lunas (paid), Menunggu (waiting — a non-cash payment not received yet), Belum Lunas (unpaid debt), Gagal (failed), or Kedaluwarsa (expired).
  • Payment method: Tunai (cash), Transfer Bank, QRIS, Piutang (pay later), or Split Pembayaran (several methods; 2 tender = two methods).
  • Order type: Di Tempat (dine in), Bawa Pulang (takeaway), or Diantar (delivery).
  • Jatuh tempo (due date) — the deadline to settle a debt.

bank.title: Account to transfer to
bank.desc: Shown for Transfer Bank (bank transfer) sales: the bank, account number, and account holder of the store's account. Show or send it to the customer so they transfer to the right account. Accounts are managed in Settings → Bank Accounts.

items.title: Items
items.desc: The items bought: Harga (unit price), Qty (quantity), and Subtotal (price × quantity). A crossed-out price with red text under the item name means the item was on promotion. On a phone, swipe the table sideways to see prices and quantities.

summary.title: Totals
summary.desc:
• Subtotal — the item prices before discounts.
  • Promo Otomatis (automatic promotion) and Diskon Manual (manual discount) — price reductions.
  • Ongkos Kirim (delivery fee) and PPN (VAT) — when they apply.
  • Total — what the customer pays.
  • Tunai (cash) and Kembali (change) — money received and change given, for cash sales.
Sales paid in several ways list each method's amount below.

receipt.title: Receipt preview
receipt.desc: This is how the receipt will look on thermal paper. Check the store name, items, and total, then press Thermal to print directly, or PDF Struk (receipt PDF) to save it.

label.title: Shipping label preview
label.desc: A label to stick on the parcel: Penerima (recipient — the customer's name and address; Ambil di Toko (pick up in store) when there is no address), the parcel contents, the amount paid, and the invoice number. The address comes from the Customers menu. Press PDF Resi to print it.

intro.title: Pengguna (users)
intro.desc:
The people who may sign in to your store app — owner, managers, and cashiers. Give every employee their own account (email and password), never a shared one, so sales and the Audit Log record who did what. What a person may open depends on their Access Group.

New employee? Press Tambah Pengguna (add user).

add.title: Tambah Pengguna (add user)
add.desc: Opens the new-user form: name, email, password, the outlets they work at, and their access group.

search.title: Search users
search.desc: Type part of a name and press Enter. The search uses names, not emails.

view.title: View
view.desc: Switch between cards and a table. In the table view, the tick box in the column header selects every user on this page at once.

list.title: User list
list.desc: Each user shows a photo or the first letter of their name, the name, the email, and their access group labels (for example cashier). The tick boxes select several users at once.

row.title: Edit and Hapus (delete)
row.desc:
• Edit (pencil) — opens the form to change the name, password, outlets, or access group.
  • Hapus (bin) — deletes the account after confirmation; that person can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone.
Your own account and the last super-admin cannot be deleted. The app may ask for your password first — check the list afterwards to make sure the account is gone.

bulk.title: Delete several
bulk.desc: Appears once you tick users: deletes every ticked user at once. Check the ticks first — deleting cannot be undone.

empty.title: No users
empty.desc: No user matches the search. Clear the search box and press Enter to see everyone.

pagination.title: Pages
pagination.desc: Users are spread over several pages, newest first. Use the page numbers or arrows to move between them.

intro.title: Add / edit a user
intro.desc: This form creates or changes someone's account, for example a new cashier. Required: Nama Lengkap (full name), Email, Kata Sandi (password, for new users), and at least one Akses Group (access group). The photo and default outlet can be skipped. This guide explains every part.

avatar.title: Avatar (optional)
avatar.desc: A photo of this person, up to 2 MB. It shows in the user list and the account menu. Without a photo, the first letter of their name is shown.

name.title: Nama Lengkap (full name)
name.desc: The person's name, for example Siti Rahma. It is printed on receipts as the cashier (Kasir: …), so use a name customers may read.

email.title: Email
email.desc: Used to sign in to the app, for example siti@gmail.com. It must not be used by another user yet. Once the account exists, the email cannot be changed here — the box is greyed out when editing.

password.title: Password
password.desc: At least 8 characters, then type the same again in Konfirmasi Kata Sandi (confirm password). When editing a user, leave both empty to keep the password — fill them in when that person has forgotten theirs. Tell the person their password in private.

outlets.title: Outlet yang Diizinkan (allowed outlets)
outlets.desc: Tick the outlets (branches) where this person may work. Cashiers can only open a shift and sell at ticked outlets, and the reports and stock they see are limited to them. If the store has more than one outlet, a user with nothing ticked cannot open a shift anywhere. Super-admins may always use every outlet.

default.title: Outlet default (optional)
default.desc: The outlet selected automatically when this person signs in. It must be one of the outlets ticked above — otherwise saving fails.

roles.title: Akses Group (access group)
roles.desc:
Tick at least one group — it decides which menus this person may open:
  • cashier — the cashier screen, shifts, customers.
  • manager — almost every store menu, but not user management.
  • super-admin — everything; for the owner only.
Other groups (for example products-access) add access to a single menu. See what each contains in the Access Groups menu.

submit.title: Save
submit.desc: Press Simpan (save; when editing: Simpan Perubahan). Wrong entries are marked in red. For safety the app may ask you to retype your own password (or press Konfirmasi dengan akun Aishii); you then return to the form and what you typed is gone — fill it in again and save. You won't be asked again for the next 15 minutes. Batal (cancel) goes back to the list without saving.

next.title: How the new user signs in
next.desc: Give the person that email and password. They open the app's sign-in page and type both into the email and password form (if a Masuk dengan akun Aishii button is shown, the form is below the words Kasir: surel dan kata sandi toko — cashiers: store email and password). A cashier then opens a shift in the Transactions menu to start selling.
